双线追索到岔口，一方举起红灯，另一方立刻停步摊开地图；核对完，他们换着背同一个工: At the fork in their two-track pursuit, one raises a red light and the other immediately stops and unfolds the map. After checking it together, they take turns carrying the same toolkit.
两条线索证明双方追错了不同的人，继续争先只会让真正目标彻底离场。: The two trails show that each side has been pursuing a different wrong person. Competing to get there first will only let the real target disappear for good.
交换完整线索，重新核实责任与目标，并在约定边界处共同结束行动。: Exchange the full set of leads, verify responsibility and objectives again, and end the operation together at the agreed boundary.
B已把损失压进合同，A却沿着签字人的脚印继续追一笔纸上没有的账。: B has already folded the loss into the contract, but A follows the signer's footprints in pursuit of a debt that appears nowhere on paper.
双方逐利，A布局追索且可能对阻挠追加代价，B直接以体面条款压出收益、达成后收束。: Both seek Gain. A uses Strategy to pursue it and may impose further costs on anyone who obstructs the chase; B directly extracts Gain through respectable contractual terms and winds down once the objective is met. B can settle the stated account, while A remains fixated on the offenses that lie outside it.
A可能觉得B拿到钱就算结束，等于放过了曾经阻挠他们的人。: A may feel that B treats getting the money as the end, effectively letting those who once obstructed them off the hook.
B可能认为A的追击没有回报，只会让已生效的合同重新陷入风险。: B may see no return in A's continued pursuit, only a risk of destabilizing a contract already in force.
对手隐藏资产时，A追出真实流向，B用条款与期限直接冻结，完成回收。: When an opponent hides assets, A traces their true flow and B uses terms and deadlines to freeze them directly, completing the recovery.
赔偿到位后A仍公布私人材料，B切断资源以止损；A遂把B列为包庇者。: After compensation is paid, A still releases private material. B cuts off resources to limit the damage, so A labels B an accomplice in the cover-up.
对账结束，B收起计算器听A讲完那道伤口，A也把追索线停在门外；两人一起替被牵连者: When the accounts are settled, B puts away the calculator and listens as A finishes describing the wound. A leaves the pursuit outside the door, and together they send replacement payments to those caught in the fallout.
追加追查将牵连无辜签字人，A必须选择是否放下旧怨，B则要不要承担当初的强压。: Further investigation would implicate innocent signatories. A must decide whether to let go of the old grudge, while B must decide whether to take responsibility for the Pressure originally applied.
完成约定赔付后封存无关材料，任何新追责都先证明新的实际责任。: Once the agreed compensation is paid, seal away irrelevant material. Any new attempt to assign responsibility must first establish a new, concrete basis for it.
B抱着箱子已经跨线离场，A仍沿着掉落的封条去找最初说过不的人。: B has already crossed the line and left with the case, while A still follows the trail of broken seals back to the first person who said no.
两人都逐利、较少依赖体面；A以布局追击反抗者，B直接取得资源且得手可停。B要成果: Both seek Gain and rely little on respectable approval. A uses Strategy to pursue those who resisted; B takes the resources directly and can stop once they are secured. B wants the result, while A also wants those who obstructed them to pay. Their operations therefore end at different points.
A可能认可B拿箱子的效率，却把对方及时撤离理解成不够忠于共同战线。: A may respect B's efficiency in taking the case, yet interpret B's timely withdrawal as insufficient loyalty to their shared front.
B可能觉得A追人胜过拿货，正在把清晰收益变成无休止的风险。: B may think A cares more about chasing people than securing the goods, turning a clear Gain into endless risk.
目标藏在多层防线后时，A设计追踪与诱导，B突破最后条件，快速带走资源。: When the objective is hidden behind several defensive layers, A designs the tracking and bait, while B breaks through the final barrier and quickly carries off the resources.
B拒绝继续追击守门者，A扣住撤离路线；B则以整箱资源迫使A放行。: B refuses to keep pursuing the gatekeeper, so A blocks the escape route. B then uses the entire case of resources as leverage to force A to let B pass.
箱子脱险后，A剪断拴在两人腕间的旧绳；B走出三步，又自愿回来接过工具箱的另一只提: Once the case is safe, A cuts the old rope binding their wrists. B walks three steps away, then voluntarily returns and takes the other handle of the toolkit.
箱中资源必须由守门者解锁，原先要惩罚的人突然变成双方共同依赖者。: The resources in the case can be unlocked only by the gatekeeper. The person they meant to punish suddenly becomes someone both depend on.
先保全目标与人员，停止追逐无关对象，并允许任一方退出后续行动。: Secure the objective and everyone's safety first, stop pursuing unrelated people, and allow either side to withdraw from any further action.
A追到最后一扇门，B带着正式文书等在那里，要把门后仅剩的东西也列入清单。: A pursues the target to the final door, where B is already waiting with formal papers, ready to add whatever remains behind it to the inventory.
双方逐利、惩罚阻挠；A借追踪布局且少求认可，B直接借程序执行并重体面依据。两人容: Both seek Gain and punish obstruction. A tracks through Strategy and seeks little approval; B acts directly through formal procedure and values a respectable basis for doing so. They can readily join forces to pursue the target to the end, but may clash over whether a private vendetta can become an official penalty.
A可能嫌B的文书太慢，却需要它让最后一击不会被轻易翻案。: A may find B's paperwork too slow, yet need it to keep the final strike from being easily overturned.
B可能利用A找到目标，也担心未经核实的追踪污染整套程序。: B may use A to locate the target, while worrying that unverified tracking will taint the entire procedure.
复杂违约中A追出隐藏受益人，B把证据变成执行清单，封住最后转移口。: In a complex breach, A traces the hidden beneficiaries and B turns the evidence into an enforcement list, closing off the final route for transferring assets.
A要求把无关亲友也列入惩罚，B拒绝后被指为动摇；B遂扣下A的证据。: A demands that unrelated friends and relatives be punished too. When B refuses, A accuses B of wavering; B then withholds A's evidence.
最后一笔证据不足，A盖上档案盒，B把红章翻面当杯垫；两人守着冷茶，等新线索自己出: With insufficient evidence for the final entry, A closes the archive box and B turns the red seal face down as a coaster. They sit over cold tea, waiting for new clues to emerge on their own.
最后财物属于第三方，拿走不会增加收益，只会证明两人是否愿意越界。: The last assets belong to a third party. Taking them would add no Gain; it would only reveal whether the two are willing to cross the line.
逐项核对所有权和责任，撤下无关对象，并设执行完成后的自动终止。: Verify ownership and responsibility item by item, remove unrelated parties, and set enforcement to end automatically once its purpose is fulfilled.
A把目标从暗巷追到摊前，B已拿到钱袋，却当众踢翻了唯一的退路。: A pursues the target from a dark alley to a street stall. B already has the money bag, yet publicly kicks over the target's only way out.
双方逐利、惩罚反抗且不重体面；A通过持续追踪收窄选择，B直接索取并公开加码。相似: Both seek Gain, punish resistance, and disregard respectable appearances. A narrows the target's options through sustained pursuit; B makes direct demands and publicly raises the stakes. Their similar aims let them ally quickly, but conflict can escalate over who leads the pursuit and who has the right to stop it.
A可能觉得B砸得太早，让后续线索和隐藏收益一起断掉。: A may think B smashed things too soon, cutting off both later leads and hidden Gain.
B可能认为A只会追踪不敢收口，必须由自己让拒绝者记住代价。: B may believe A can track but never dares to bring matters to a close, so B must personally make sure that those who refuse remember the cost.
对手不断转移位置时，A锁定行动路线，B守住出口直接施压，迫使资源交出。: As an opponent keeps changing locations, A pins down the route while B guards the exit and applies direct Pressure, forcing the resources to be surrendered.
钱袋已到手B仍毁掉线索载体，A认定自己的追踪被轻视，开始追查B的旧事。: Even after securing the money bag, B destroys the medium carrying the clues. A sees this as contempt for the pursuit and begins digging into B's past.
送回补好的摊架后，A收起追索清单，B把自己的外套递过去；两人并肩等末班车，没有人: After returning the repaired stall frame, A puts away the pursuit list and B offers A a coat. They wait side by side for the last bus, and neither asks who admitted defeat first.
被堵者提出一条更大的共同线索，继续惩罚会永远失去它，目标优先级被迫重排。: The trapped person offers a larger lead valuable to them both. Further punishment would lose it forever, forcing them to reorder their priorities.
保全证据和退路，停止公开羞辱，在资源归还后重新决定是否依法追责。: Preserve the evidence and a route out, stop the public humiliation, and decide again after the resources are returned whether to pursue responsibility through lawful channels.
A踩着断掉的控制线往上追，B握着操纵杆，第一次发现棋子会寻找那只手。: A follows a snapped control line backstage, while B grips the controls and realizes for the first time that a pawn can search for the hand moving it.
双方偏好安排局面。A握有断线后的线索，可能继续追索；B重全局决定权与体面秩序，目: Both prefer to shape events through Strategy. A holds the trail left by the broken line and may keep pursuing it; B values overall Control and respectable order, and may wind down once the objective is met. B wants to make use of the trail, while A refuses to remain merely a pawn.
A可能把B的精细调度看成对自己的利用，越被隐藏越想追到源头。: A may see B's precise coordination as exploitation, and the more it is concealed, the more determined A becomes to trace it to the source.
B可能欣赏A能追穿防线，却低估对方发现被操控后的余账。: B may admire A's ability to pursue a trail through every defense, yet underestimate the reckoning that follows when A discovers the manipulation.
组织遭渗透时，B布置多条假线，A沿反应追出入口，两人能锁定真正对手。: When the organization is infiltrated, B lays several false trails and A follows the reactions back to the point of entry. Together they can identify the real opponent.
A发现自己也是诱饵，任务完成后仍追问幕后决定；B切线止损，A便追向B本人。: A discovers that A was also used as bait and keeps demanding to know who made the decision behind the scenes after the mission is over. B cuts the line to contain the damage, so A turns the pursuit toward B.
断线前，B把操纵杆推到A也够得着的位置，A则摊开追来的线索；两人用双色铅笔重画下: Before the line breaks, B pushes the controls within A's reach, while A spreads out the leads gathered in pursuit. Together they redraw the next stretch of the route in two colors.
更强对手同时抓住两人的线，主从结构转成共同受制，迫使他们重新结盟。: A stronger opponent seizes both of their lines at once. Their superior-subordinate structure becomes shared captivity, forcing them to ally again.
公开控制链与风险，解除未经同意的角色安排，并停止追查无关私人信息。: Disclose the chain of control and its risks, undo role assignments made without consent, and stop investigating unrelated private information.
B把一个名字喊进人群，A顺着每一次回声追去，直到原声早已换了主人。: B shouts a name into the crowd, and A follows every echo until the original voice has long since acquired a new owner.
双方都借间接路径且轻视体面限制；A逐利并可能持续追罚，B重群体方向、达成控制后可: Both work through indirect paths and disregard respectable constraints. A seeks Gain and may continue punitive pursuit; B prioritizes directing the group and can stop once Control is achieved. B creates the clues and the hunting ground, while A leaves the named person no way out.
A可能认为B只负责点火却不肯陪自己追到底，随时准备换新议题。: A may think B merely lights the fire but refuses to join the pursuit to the end, always ready to move on to a new cause.
B可能把A的执着当有用威慑，也怕追击反噬自己对人群的控制。: B may treat A's persistence as a useful deterrent, while fearing that the pursuit will rebound and undermine B's Control over the crowd.
寻找隐匿对手时，B发动多人提供碎片信息，A筛出路径并持续逼近真实位置。: When searching for a hidden opponent, B mobilizes many people to supply fragments of information, while A filters them into a path and steadily closes in on the real location.
B发现目标已无价值而转向新口号，A仍追旧人并引用B的话，迫使B公开切割。: B decides the target is no longer useful and moves on to a new slogan, but A keeps pursuing the old target while quoting B's words, forcing B to publicly disavow the campaign.
回声散尽，B独自关掉召集灯，A把工作线索封好留在桌上；午夜两人凭约定来到旧广场，: When the echoes fade, B switches off the rally light alone, while A seals the working notes and leaves them on the table. At midnight, both arrive at the old square as agreed and exchange cups of still-warm coffee.
回声显示最初消息由第三方伪造，两人若不停手就会共同伤及无辜者。: The echoes reveal that a third party fabricated the original message. If the two do not stop, they will jointly harm innocent people.
撤下点名内容，停止群众追踪，核实原始消息并为误伤提供公开更正。: Remove the content that names individuals, stop the crowd from tracking them, verify the original message, and issue a public correction for those harmed by mistake.
A把目标一路追到评审门前，B翻开旧档案，早已为不服从预留了零分。: A pursues the target all the way to the review-room door, where B opens an old file that had long reserved a score of zero for disobedience.
双方都偏好安排局面，也可能让挑战者付出代价。本局A从旧车票得知目标去向，B握有延: Both prefer to shape events through Strategy, and both may make challengers pay a price. Here, A learns the target's destination from an old ticket, while B holds review authority to extend the sanction. Their standards of evidence, however, may conflict.
A可能嫌B只在档案里惩罚，却需要那张零分牌封死目标的后路。: A may fault B for punishing only on paper, yet need that zero-score card to close off the target's last escape route.
B可能利用A搜集踪迹，也担心越界证据会让裁决失去体面。: B may use A to collect traces, while worrying that evidence obtained across boundaries will strip the ruling of its respectable legitimacy.

收割者嫌煽动家把可计算的租金问题变成难收场的忠诚表态。: The Harvester resents the Agitator for turning a calculable rent dispute into a declaration of loyalty that is hard to bring to a close.
煽动家觉得收割者只会挤数字，却提供了点燃人群的真实火星。: The Agitator thinks the Harvester only knows how to squeeze numbers, yet recognizes that the Harvester has supplied the real spark needed to ignite the crowd.
旧市场改造中，收割者划出利益条件，煽动家动员商户接受新的分配。: During the redevelopment of an old market, the Harvester defines the terms of Gain while the Agitator mobilizes merchants to accept the new allocation.
煽动家为夺话语权公开夸大涨幅，收割者的体面方案当场失去信用。: Seeking control of the narrative, the Agitator publicly exaggerates the increase, instantly discrediting the Harvester's respectable plan.
煽动家关掉扩音器，陪收割者逐张数完租约；收割者把一枚没有附带条件的门钥匙放进他掌: The Agitator switches off the loudspeaker and helps the Harvester count through every lease. The Harvester places a door key with no conditions attached in the Agitator's palm.
一位商户现场逐条读出合同，情绪口号与隐性费用同时被照亮。: A merchant reads the contract aloud clause by clause, exposing both the emotional slogan and the hidden fees.
双方共同更正数字、暂停动员，并给受影响者一段无惩罚撤回期。: Correct the figures together, pause the mobilization, and give affected people a penalty-free period in which to withdraw.
一个制定进场费，一个决定谁交同样的钱却得不同座位。: One sets the admission fee; the other decides who pays the same amount but receives a different seat.
双方共享谋求可辩护外观的饰端，但目标与伤害路径不同：收割者以利压用换取收益，权术: Both share a tendency toward Justification, seeking a defensible appearance, but their objectives and paths of harm differ. The Harvester uses Gain, Pressure, and Instrumental harm to secure returns; the Power Broker uses Control, Strategy, and Punitive harm to preserve authority to judge, and may pursue challengers.
收割者看重权术家手里的评分权，却怕标准随亲疏改变成本。: The Harvester values the Power Broker's authority to score, but fears that standards shaped by closeness or distance will alter the cost.
权术家认为收割者可当收费执行者，但不能让其用利润左右裁定。: The Power Broker sees the Harvester as someone who can enforce fee collection, but will not let the Harvester's pursuit of profit sway the ruling.
在一项资格竞标中，一人设保证金和违约价，一人安排评审次序与解释口径。: In a bid for eligibility, one sets the deposit and price of default, while the other arranges the order of review and the official interpretation.
收割者接受了高价补救，权术家仍要封杀曾公开质疑评分的人。: The Harvester accepts an expensive remedy, but the Power Broker still wants to blacklist those who publicly questioned the score.
复核室只剩一盏灯，权术家先把自己的评分牌放上桌，收割者也亮出成本底稿；两人替彼此: Only one light remains in the review room. The Power Broker puts the scoring card on the table first, and the Harvester reveals the underlying cost sheet. Each preserves the other's right to veto one item.
匿名复评把被压低的方案判为第一，双方必须选择承认还是改写规则。: An anonymous reassessment ranks the undervalued proposal first, forcing both sides to choose whether to accept the result or rewrite the rules.
权术家公开评分依据，收割者退回与结果挂钩的秘密费用。: The Power Broker discloses the basis for the scores, and the Harvester returns the secret fee tied to the outcome.
台上说这是共同使命，台下每一次奉献都有抽成。: Onstage it is called a shared mission; backstage, every act of devotion yields a commission.
两人都可能收窄他人的选择，但路径不同：收割者用明确条件索取收益并保留正当外观，教: Both may narrow other people's choices, but by different routes. The Harvester uses explicit conditions to demand Gain while preserving a legitimate appearance; the Cult Leader uses relationships and narrative to remain the personal center, and may punish those who leave.
收割者觉得教主能把缴付变成信念，但清退异议会损伤长期现金流。: The Harvester thinks the Cult Leader can turn payment into belief, but that purging dissent will damage long-term cash flow.
教主把收割者视为管理奉献的务实助手，也提防他只认收益不认忠诚。: The Cult Leader sees the Harvester as a practical assistant for managing contributions, while guarding against an assistant who recognizes Gain but not loyalty.
两人筹办封闭社群：教主塑造共同使命，收割者设置会员等级与资源门槛。: They build a closed community together: the Cult Leader shapes a shared mission, while the Harvester sets membership tiers and barriers to resources.
成员提出退款时，收割者愿意止损放人，教主却把退出解释成必须处置的背叛。: When a member asks for a refund, the Harvester is willing to limit the loss and let the member leave, but the Cult Leader interprets departure as a betrayal that must be punished.
社群散会后，教主摘下话筒来帮收割者封存账箱；账箱留两把钥匙，谁想离场都能带走自己: After the community meeting, the Cult Leader puts down the microphone and helps the Harvester seal the cashbox. The box has two keys, and either person can take their own key if they choose to leave.
最忠诚的成员公开求助，原本好用的制度忽然成为两人是否负责的考题。: The most loyal member publicly asks for help, turning the once-useful system into a sudden test of whether the two will take responsibility.
当场开放退出通道、返还未使用费用，并停止追踪离开者。: Open an exit immediately, refund unused fees, and stop tracking those who leave.
一个计算每份能少给多少，一个确保所有人按表领取。: One calculates how little can be given in each share; the other ensures everyone collects strictly according to the table.
双方共享压、用、饰，借制度化强制达成目标并在完成后收束；收割者以利为先，铁腕者以: Both favor Pressure, Instrumental harm, and Justification, using institutional force to reach an objective and stopping once it is achieved. The Harvester prioritizes Gain, while the Enforcer prioritizes Control: one cares about resources that can be taken, the other about whether orders take effect.
收割者欣赏铁腕者执行稳定，却不懂为何宁可少赚也不肯放松次序。: The Harvester admires the Enforcer's consistency, but cannot understand why the Enforcer would accept less Gain rather than loosen the order.
铁腕者认为收割者能精算配给，但随价格变动立场会削弱纪律。: The Enforcer believes the Harvester can calculate rations precisely, but that changing position with the price will weaken discipline.
灾后仓库里，一人核定交换额度，一人按顺序守住领用通道。: In a post-disaster warehouse, one sets the allowable terms of exchange while the other guards the distribution lane and enforces the order of collection.
收割者想把余量卖给高价者，铁腕者坚持先服从既定配给指令。: The Harvester wants to sell the surplus to the highest bidder, while the Enforcer insists on obeying the established rationing order first.
收割者把最后一份配给留在桌上，铁腕者解除门禁陪他重数库存；确认无误后，两人一起把: The Harvester leaves the final ration on the table, and the Enforcer unlocks the door to recount the inventory together. Once the numbers are confirmed, they return the keys side by side.
库存数字被证实算错，继续执行与重新分配分别威胁两人最看重的东西。: The inventory count proves wrong. Continuing distribution threatens what one values most, while reallocating it threatens what the other values most.
暂停发放，共同重数库存，并让受影响者参与确认新配给表。: Pause distribution, recount the inventory together, and let affected people participate in confirming the new rationing table.
一个不断改价，一个只需盖章让新价立刻生效。: One keeps changing the price; the other needs only a stamp to make each new price take effect at once.
两人都偏压与用，倾向直接提出条件、达到目标后可收束。收割者优先实际利益并需要体面: Both favor Pressure and Instrumental harm, tending to impose conditions directly and stop once the objective is met. The Harvester prioritizes concrete Gain and needs a respectable Justification; the Decider prioritizes Control and relies less on normative approval.
收割者把定局者的一句话视作最短交易链，也怕其随时推翻算好的价。: The Harvester sees a word from the Decider as the shortest possible transaction chain, but fears the Decider may overturn the calculated price at any moment.
定局者认为收割者会把命令变成收益，却可能拿条款拖慢个人决断。: The Decider believes the Harvester can turn an order into Gain, but may use contractual terms to slow a personal decision.
在限量货源争夺中，定局者拍板唯一渠道，收割者把额度拆成高价层级。: In a contest over limited supplies, the Decider designates the sole channel, while the Harvester divides access into high-priced tiers.
定局者为显示最终决定权临时免掉费用，收割者的利润模型瞬间失效。: To demonstrate final Control, the Decider suddenly waives the fee, instantly breaking the Harvester's profit model.
定局者把印章推到桌子中央，收割者撕掉礼物背后的价签；这次行程由两人各选一半，任何: The Decider pushes the seal to the center of the table, and the Harvester tears the price tag off the gift. This time, each chooses half the itinerary, and either may change their mind at any stop.
货源突然变得充足，原先靠稀缺维持的合作失去共同抓手。: Supply suddenly becomes abundant, removing the shared point of leverage that had sustained their cooperation through scarcity.
定局者撤回单方批示，收割者公布成本并给对方可拒绝的新方案。: The Decider withdraws the unilateral directive, while the Harvester discloses the costs and gives the other party a new proposal they are free to reject.
工资袋被拧紧，提出异议的那一页也正被撕掉。: The wage purse is being tightened while the page containing the objection is torn out.
双方共享压与饰，偏好让强制拥有制度外观；收割者是利与用，收益到手即可收束，裁决者: Both favor Pressure and Justification, preferring coercion to carry an institutional appearance. The Harvester is oriented toward Gain and Instrumental harm, stopping once the return is secured; the Arbiter is oriented toward Control and Punitive harm, and is more likely to treat dissent as a challenge requiring further punishment.
收割者觉得裁决者能压住反弹，却会消灭有价值的预警与谈判余地。: The Harvester thinks the Arbiter can suppress backlash, but will also destroy valuable warnings and room for negotiation.
裁决者认为收割者只想持续收取，不愿处理挑战制度的人。: The Arbiter believes the Harvester merely wants to keep collecting and is unwilling to deal with those who challenge the system.
一项内部削减中，收割者设计扣减档位，裁决者统一执行并封住程序漏洞。: During an internal cutback, the Harvester designs tiers of deductions, while the Arbiter applies them uniformly and closes procedural loopholes.
有人补足全部损失后仍被追责，收割者认为过度，裁决者认为必须示范。: Even after someone repays the entire loss, the Arbiter still seeks punishment. The Harvester calls it excessive; the Arbiter calls it a necessary example.
裁决者从碎纸机旁救回那页质疑，收割者在账本上注销人情债；两人坐到天亮，只核事实，: The Arbiter rescues the page of objections from beside the shredder, while the Harvester writes off the personal debt in the ledger. They sit until dawn, checking only facts and never demanding proof of loyalty.
被删除的意见恰好预警重大亏损，两人的强制秩序反过来威胁共同成果。: The deleted opinion turns out to have warned of a major loss. The coercive order they built now threatens their shared result.
恢复申诉记录、停止追加处分，并由双方签字返还不当扣款。: Restore the record of appeals, stop additional sanctions, and have both sides sign off on returning the improper deductions.
一个把仓库榨到见底，一个还要所有人看着按钮落下。: One squeezes the warehouse bare; the other insists that everyone watch the button come down.
两人都偏压，能收窄选择；收割者以利、用、饰组织可辩护的取利，暴君以权、惩、蔑维护: Both favor Pressure and can narrow others' choices. The Harvester organizes defensible extraction through Gain, Instrumental harm, and Justification; the Tyrant uses Control, Punitive harm, and Disregard to preserve final authority and may impose further costs. Their cooperation readily breaks at the question of when enough is enough.
收割者敬畏暴君的最终权限，也清楚任性惩罚会让仓库永远空掉。: The Harvester fears and respects the Tyrant's ultimate authority, while knowing that arbitrary punishment will leave the warehouse empty forever.
暴君把收割者当作高效征收者，却厌恶他用收益衡量服从。: The Tyrant treats the Harvester as an efficient collector, but despises measuring obedience by Gain.
围城物资紧缺时，一人设置征收比例，一人强令所有通道按同一命令关闭。: When supplies are scarce during a siege, one sets the collection rate while the other orders every route closed under a single command.
物资已经收齐，暴君仍要惩办迟交者，收割者担心生产者彻底逃散。: The supplies have all been collected, but the Tyrant still wants to punish late contributors. The Harvester fears the producers will scatter for good.
清仓结束，收割者合起账本，暴君也把明日安排放到一旁；两人各提一盏灯，选择一起去看: When the warehouse is cleared, the Harvester closes the ledger and the Tyrant also sets tomorrow's plans aside. Carrying one lamp each, they choose to see the morning outside together.
暴君发现收割者私留应急仓，两人立刻从共治者变成彼此最危险的知情人。: The Tyrant discovers that the Harvester kept a private emergency stockpile. The two instantly change from co-rulers into each other's most dangerous witnesses.
公开应急库存、解除集体惩罚，并让第三方保管唯一启动权。: Disclose the emergency stockpile, end collective punishment, and place sole authority to activate it in the hands of a third party.
两个人都抱着箱子冲向出口，却只有一张通行证。: Two people run toward the exit carrying cases, but there is only one pass.
两人同为利压用蔑，都可能直接取走资源，达到目的后便停止，也不依赖体面解释；差异由: Both share Gain, Pressure, Instrumental harm, and Disregard. Either may take resources directly, stop once the objective is met, and dispense with respectable explanations. Their positions create the difference: one reached the cases first, while the other controls the exit and transport.
先拿箱者把守出口者看成临时路障，也可能是唯一能开车的人。: The one who reached the cases first sees the person guarding the exit as a temporary obstacle, and perhaps the only one who can drive.
守出口者认为对方抢得快，却把撤离成本全甩给自己。: The one guarding the exit thinks the other was quick to seize the goods but left the entire cost of escape behind.
仓库即将封闭，两人按重量分工，一人搬箱、一人驾驶，约定到站再分。: With the warehouse about to close, they divide the work by weight: one carries the cases, the other drives, and they agree to divide the contents on arrival.
出口只剩一个座位，双方都用自己掌握的资源要求对方先放手。: Only one seat remains at the exit, and each uses the resource under their control to demand that the other let go first.
岔路口，两人同时放下箱子摊开地图，各自圈出愿走的路；发现方向不同，也允许对方带走: At the fork, they both set down their cases and unfold the map, each circling a route they are willing to take. When they find their directions differ, each still allows the other to leave with their own share.
他们发现箱上另有失主求救标记，撤离任务突然多出必须共同承担的后果。: They discover a distress mark from the cases' true owner. The escape now carries consequences both must share.
把箱子放回地面，核对物权后重新写明份额、路线和退出条件。: Put the cases back on the ground, verify ownership, and rewrite the shares, routes, and conditions for withdrawal.
一个撕封搬箱，一个拿着文书追到最后一只罐子。: One tears the seal and carries off cases; the other follows with formal papers all the way to the last jar.
两人共享利与压，都会直接争取资源；掠夺者偏用蔑，取到所需便走且不修饰越界，清算者: Both favor Gain and Pressure, directly competing for resources. 掠夺者觉得清算者拿得不够快，还浪费时间证明每一笔都该拿。: The Raider thinks the Collector takes too slowly and wastes time proving that every item is rightfully theirs to take.
清算者认为掠夺者只会破门，留下的程序漏洞最后都要自己补。: The Collector thinks the Raider only knows how to break down doors, leaving the Collector to repair every procedural gap afterward.
追回被转移资产时，掠夺者截住货物，清算者凭文件完成登记与处置。: While recovering transferred assets, the Raider intercepts the goods and the Collector uses documents to complete their registration and disposition.
目标资产已归位，清算者还要追加禁入，掠夺者却想立刻转去下一单。: The target assets have been restored, but the Collector still wants to impose an additional ban, while the Raider wants to move immediately to the next job.
清算者盖下结案章，掠夺者把多拿的罐子塞回空柜；门外下雨，两人自愿共撑一把伞走完归: The Collector applies the case-closing stamp, and the Raider puts the extra jar back in the empty cabinet. It is raining outside; they voluntarily share an umbrella all the way home.
被追缴者证明自己只是代管，双方必须承认速度与程序都可能伤及无辜。: The person facing recovery proves to have been only a custodian. Both sides must admit that speed and procedure can each harm innocent people.
停止搬运与追缴，封存争议物，并给代管者一次独立申诉机会。: Stop moving and recovering the property, seal the disputed items, and give the custodian an independent opportunity to appeal.
箱子早已到手，另一脚却还停在摊架上方。: The case is already in hand, yet another foot still hovers above the market stall.
双方同为利压蔑，都可能公开强取资源，不倚赖体面辩护；用与惩区分回合终点，掠夺者可: Both share Gain, Pressure, and Disregard, and may openly seize resources without respectable Justification. Instrumental versus Punitive harm determines when each stops: the Raider may leave as soon as the goods are secured, while the Bruiser may keep destroying property to punish resistance.
掠夺者把悍客视作会多做无收益动作的同路人，声势大却拖慢撤离。: The Raider sees the Bruiser as a fellow traveler who takes extra actions with no Gain: impressive in spectacle, but slow in retreat.
悍客嫌掠夺者拿到就走，像是默许反抗者没有真正认输。: The Bruiser resents the Raider for leaving as soon as the goods are secured, as if conceding that the resisters never truly surrendered.
在码头截货时，掠夺者负责抱走目标箱，悍客占住通道吓退追赶者。: While intercepting cargo at the docks, the Raider carries off the target case and the Bruiser occupies the passage to frighten off pursuers.
货已装船，悍客仍要砸掉对方设备，掠夺者拒绝承担暴露和延误。: The cargo is aboard, but the Bruiser still wants to smash the other side's equipment. The Raider refuses to accept the exposure and delay.
归还箱子后，悍客修好被踢坏的凳脚，掠夺者递上螺丝；收工时两人把工具分好，主动约了: After returning the case, the Bruiser repairs the kicked and broken stool leg while the Raider hands over the screws. When the job is done, they divide the tools and willingly arrange to meet again.
退路只容一人通过，原本并肩的强取者第一次面对谁愿意让路。: The escape route admits only one person, forcing the two who seized things side by side to face for the first time the question of who will yield.
悍客收脚并赔回损坏物，掠夺者把多拿的一份放回原位。: The Bruiser lowers the raised foot and pays for the damage, while the Raider puts the extra share back where it belongs.
一个负责把箱子抱走，一个提前让守门人看向别处。: One carries the case away; the other makes sure in advance that the guard is looking elsewhere.
两人共享用端，行动可止于目标；掠夺者以利压蔑直接夺取资源，操盘手以权谋饰安排路径: Both share Instrumental harm, so their actions can stop once the objective is met. The Raider uses Gain, Pressure, and Disregard to seize resources directly; the Puppet Master uses Control, Strategy, and Justification to arrange paths and decision rights. One supplies momentum, while the other controls how the situation is interpreted.
掠夺者承认操盘手能清空道路，却讨厌自己只是被拨动的一根线。: The Raider admits the Puppet Master can clear the road, but hates being merely a string for someone else to pull.
操盘手把掠夺者当成精准破口工具，也担心他临场多拿目标外资源。: The Puppet Master treats the Raider as a precise breaching tool, while worrying that the Raider will seize resources beyond the objective in the moment.
艺术品转运中，操盘手错开巡查路线，掠夺者按时带走指定箱并撤离。: During the transfer of artworks, the Puppet Master staggers patrol routes, and the Raider removes the designated case on time and withdraws.
掠夺者发现额外藏品临时改道，打乱操盘手维持全局控制的时间表。: The Raider discovers additional pieces and changes course to take them, disrupting the Puppet Master's timetable for maintaining overall Control.
操盘手主动交出完整路线图，掠夺者把计划外物品放回原位；两人各选一段路领走，不把对: The Puppet Master voluntarily hands over the full route map, and the Raider returns the unplanned items. Each chooses one section of the route to lead, without secretly assigning the other a hidden role.
计划中的替罪者是两人的共同旧友，执行与改线同时变成关系选择。: The planned scapegoat is an old friend of them both, turning both execution and rerouting into a choice about the relationship.
操盘手交出完整路线图，掠夺者归还计划外物品并暂停行动。: The Puppet Master hands over the complete route map, while the Raider returns the unplanned items and pauses the operation.
人群被喊向东边时，西边仓门已经空了。: While the crowd is summoned east, the warehouse doors in the west have already been emptied.
两人共享用与蔑，可能坦然忽略主流解释并在目标实现后转场；掠夺者追逐资源、偏直接施: Both share Instrumental harm and Disregard, and may openly ignore mainstream explanations before moving on once the objective is achieved. The Raider pursues resources and favors direct Pressure; the Agitator pursues command of the situation and rearranges emotions and factions.
掠夺者觉得煽动家的声浪很好用，却不信任没有实物的权势收益。: The Raider finds the Agitator's wave of public feeling useful, but distrusts power that yields no tangible resources.
煽动家把掠夺者视作能制造事实的人，也怕他搬空舞台后立即离场。: The Agitator sees the Raider as someone who can create facts on the ground, but fears the Raider will empty the stage and immediately leave.
争夺码头仓位时，煽动家引开抗议人群，掠夺者迅速占住并搬走货物。: In a contest for dockside storage space, the Agitator draws the protesting crowd away while the Raider quickly occupies the space and removes the goods.
掠夺者提前撤走扩音设备换钱，让煽动家在关键动员中失去中心。: The Raider removes the sound equipment early to sell it, depriving the Agitator of center stage during a crucial mobilization.
人群散去后，煽动家收起扩音器，掠夺者扛起共同器材却把麦克风留给他；两人安静走过空: After the crowd disperses, the Agitator puts away the loudspeaker. The Raider shoulders their shared equipment but leaves the microphone for the Agitator, and they walk quietly across the empty docks.
人群忽然不再跟随口号，实物与号召的价值排序当场反转。: The crowd suddenly stops following the slogans, instantly reversing the relative value of tangible goods and the power to rally people.
归还扩音设备、停止调动人群，并公开仓位与货物的实际去向。: Return the sound equipment, stop mobilizing the crowd, and disclose the storage space and the goods' actual destination.
一个从侧门搬走奖品，一个在台上重写谁配得上它。: One carries the prize out through a side door; the other rewrites onstage who deserves to own it.
两人都可能把他人当成实现目标的位置，但结构差异明显：掠夺者利压用蔑，直接拿走资源: Both may treat other people as positions used to achieve an objective, but their structures differ sharply. The Raider uses Gain, Pressure, Instrumental harm, and Disregard to take resources directly. The Power Broker uses Control, Strategy, Punitive harm, and Justification to control judgment and interpretation, and may punish those who question them.
掠夺者认为权术家绕太多弯，不过一张判决确实能替箱子换主人。: The Raider thinks the Power Broker takes too many detours, but admits that a single ruling really can transfer ownership of the case.
权术家嫌掠夺者破坏体面，却需要他把偏向性的判决变成既成事实。: The Power Broker resents the Raider for ruining the respectable appearance, yet needs the Raider to turn a partial ruling into an accomplished fact.
奖项争议中，权术家改写评审口径，掠夺者在混乱中转移关键样品。: In a dispute over an award, the Power Broker rewrites the review criteria, while the Raider moves a crucial sample amid the confusion.
掠夺者私吞样品变卖，权术家失去用它奖惩阵营的筹码。: The Raider secretly takes the sample and sells it, depriving the Power Broker of leverage for rewarding and punishing factions.
权术家把两块评分牌扣在桌上，掠夺者归还误拿的奖品；他们不问输赢，各自挑一张旧海报: The Power Broker places both scoring cards face down on the table, and the Raider returns the prize taken by mistake. Without asking who won, each chooses an old poster to take away.
获奖者拒绝领奖并公开证据，两人的台前解释与后台行动同时暴露。: The winner refuses the award and publishes the evidence, exposing both their public explanation and their backstage actions.
归还样品，撤销临时判决，并交由无利益关系者重新评审。: Return the sample, revoke the interim ruling, and arrange a fresh review by people with no stake in the outcome.
一个要整箱贡品，一个要献上贡品的人继续相信。: One wants the entire case of tribute; the other wants those offering it to keep believing.
两人共享蔑端，对主流规范解释依赖较低；掠夺者以利压用直接取得资源，教主以权谋惩塑: Both share Disregard and rely relatively little on mainstream normative approval. The Raider uses Gain, Pressure, and Instrumental harm to obtain resources directly; the Cult Leader uses Control, Strategy, and Punitive harm to shape obedience and belonging. Further pursuit of those who leave is the main fault line between them.
掠夺者看中教主聚拢资源的能力，却对忠诚仪式没有耐心。: The Raider values the Cult Leader's ability to gather resources, but has no patience for rituals of loyalty.
教主认为掠夺者能护送贡箱，却担心他拿够就走、不受信念约束。: The Cult Leader believes the Raider can escort the tribute case, but worries that the Raider will leave once enough has been taken, unconstrained by belief.
迁移据点时，教主维持成员跟随，掠夺者直接控制车队和重要物资。: While relocating their base, the Cult Leader keeps members following, while the Raider directly controls the convoy and critical supplies.
掠夺者愿让一名成员带物资离开，教主坚持退出者必须留下代价。: The Raider is willing to let one member leave with supplies, but the Cult Leader insists that anyone who exits must pay a price.
教主解开车门，掠夺者把每人的私人物品逐件卸下；清点完毕后，两人仍自愿坐上同一辆空: The Cult Leader unlocks the vehicle doors, and the Raider unloads each person's belongings one by one. Once everything is accounted for, they still voluntarily board the same empty vehicle.
贡箱里只有象征物没有实用资源，两人对这场事业价值的理解突然分叉。: The tribute case contains only symbols and no practical resources, abruptly dividing their ideas of what the cause is worth.
解开车门与人员限制，清点并返还私人财物，停止追究退出者。: Unlock the vehicle doors and release restrictions on people, inventory and return personal belongings, and stop pursuing those who leave.
一个越线夺货，一个把整条线改成不得通行。: One crosses the line to seize goods; the other changes the entire line into a no-entry zone.
两人共享压与用，常以直接限制推进目标并在达成后收束；掠夺者偏利蔑，要实际资源且不: Both share Pressure and Instrumental harm, often advancing an objective through direct restrictions and stopping once it is met. The Raider favors Gain and Disregard, wants tangible resources, and cares little for presentation. The Enforcer favors Control and Justification, wants orders to take effect, and can explain them through order.
掠夺者觉得铁腕者守线太认真，却也知道纪律能让撤离通道保持畅通。: The Raider thinks the Enforcer takes guarding the line too seriously, but also knows that discipline keeps the route of withdrawal clear.
铁腕者把掠夺者当成强执行者，同时警惕他为一箱货破坏整个队列。: The Enforcer treats the Raider as a powerful executor, while guarding against the Raider disrupting the entire line for one case of goods.
封锁区撤运中，铁腕者维持单向通道，掠夺者负责抢救最有价值设备。: During an evacuation from a sealed zone, the Enforcer keeps traffic moving one way while the Raider salvages the most valuable equipment.
掠夺者越过次序先运自己的箱，直接挑战铁腕者对全场安排的权威。: The Raider jumps the queue to move their own case first, directly challenging the Enforcer's authority over the entire operation.
夜间守线时，铁腕者把备用钥匙递过去，掠夺者只搬清单上的箱子；换岗铃响，两人同时为: During the night watch, the Enforcer hands over the spare key, and the Raider moves only the cases on the list. When the shift-change bell rings, each leaves a light on for the other.
最值钱的设备堵住救援出口，两人必须在资源与指令目标之间即时选择。: The most valuable equipment blocks the rescue exit, forcing them to choose at once between securing resources and fulfilling the mission.
先清空救援通道，再由双方共同登记并分配剩余货物。: Clear the rescue route first, then have both sides jointly record and distribute the remaining goods.
一个抢走旗子换资源，一个认为旗子只该插在自己脚边。: One seizes the flag to trade for resources; the other believes it belongs planted at their own feet.
两人共享压、用、蔑，可能直接行动且不靠规范认可，目标实现后也可停止；掠夺者优先实: Both favor Pressure, Instrumental harm, and Disregard. They may act directly without seeking normative approval, and can stop once the objective is achieved. The Raider prioritizes material Gain; the Decider prioritizes final Control, so the flag means something different to each.
掠夺者觉得定局者为象征控制牺牲实利很不划算，却能提供强力通行。: The Raider thinks the Decider sacrifices too much material Gain for symbolic Control, though that Control can secure powerful access.
定局者把掠夺者看成能取物的先锋，也鄙视他随收益改变归属。: The Decider sees the Raider as a capable advance operative, but despises how readily the Raider changes allegiance for Gain.
争取新据点时，定局者决定推进方向，掠夺者抢下补给和关键钥匙。: While securing a new base, the Decider decides the direction of advance and the Raider seizes supplies and a crucial key.
掠夺者想卖掉象征胜利的旗子，定局者认定这是挑战最终领导权。: The Raider wants to sell the flag that symbolizes victory; the Decider sees this as a challenge to ultimate authority.
定局者把旗子折好交给掠夺者保管，掠夺者没有拿去换价，只带回一只指南针；下段路由对: The Decider folds the flag and entrusts it to the Raider. The Raider does not trade it away, returning with only a compass; the other chooses the next leg of the route.
旗子被证明只是诱饵，真正补给藏在双方都曾忽视的旧路线。: The flag proves to be a decoy; the real supplies lie hidden along an old route both had overlooked.
定局者让出一次路线决定，掠夺者放回共同象征并公开所得。: The Decider yields one decision about the route; the Raider returns their shared symbol and discloses what was gained.
一个搬走证物箱，一个把提过问题的记录也清空。: One carries away the evidence case; the other erases every record of anyone who raised questions.
双方共享压端，都会直接收窄选择推进目标；掠夺者利压用蔑，拿走资源即止，裁决者权压: Both share Pressure and directly narrow others' choices to advance their objective. The Raider combines Gain, Pressure, Instrumental harm, and Disregard, stopping once the resources are taken. The Arbiter combines Control, Pressure, Punitive harm, and Justification, valuing obedience more and using an institutional facade to keep suppressing dissent.
掠夺者觉得裁决者销毁记录多此一举，东西到手才是明确收益。: The Raider sees the Arbiter's destruction of records as needless; taking possession of the goods is the only concrete Gain.
裁决者认为掠夺者只懂搬箱，不懂让挑战者从系统里消失。: Arbiter believes that Raider only knows to move boxes and not to allow challengers to disappear from the system.
突击封存时，掠夺者控制实物仓库，裁决者冻结权限并统一文件出口。: During a surprise seizure, the Raider takes control of the physical warehouse while the Arbiter freezes access and centralizes the release of documents.
掠夺者打算卖掉证物，裁决者要保留它作为惩戒与服从的工具。: Raider intends to sell the evidence, and Arbiter will retain it as a tool of discipline and obedience.
裁决者恢复那份被删的记录，掠夺者把证物箱原封推回；两人各留一把仓门钥匙，也都可以: The Arbiter restores the deleted record, and the Raider pushes the evidence case back unopened. Each keeps a key to the warehouse, and either is free not to return.
证物证明两人执行对象无辜，继续掩盖会把彼此变成唯一知情者。: The evidence proves their target was innocent; continuing the cover-up would make each the other's only witness.
停止转移和删档，恢复原始记录，并把证物交给独立保管人。: Stop the transfer and deletion, restore the original records and hand over the exhibits to the independent custodian.
一个献上夺来的东西，一个还要献物者跪着说明归属。: One presents what was seized; the other demands that the bearer kneel and declare who it belongs to.
两人共享压与蔑，可能公开收窄他人选择；掠夺者以利用伤害服务获取资源，暴君以权惩维: Both favor Pressure and Disregard, and may openly narrow others' choices. The Raider uses Instrumental harm to obtain resources; the Tyrant uses Control and Punitive harm to preserve ultimate domination, and may keep forcing submission even after the goods are secured.
掠夺者把暴君视作最大买家与最大风险，价款随一次不悦就会失效。: The Raider sees the Tyrant as both the biggest buyer and the greatest risk: one moment of displeasure can void the payment.
暴君欣赏掠夺者敢抢，却不能容忍他把效忠看作随时可卖的服务。: The Tyrant admires the Raider's willingness to seize what they want, but cannot tolerate treating loyalty as a service always available for sale.
争夺稀有物时，暴君封死外部退路，掠夺者负责快速取回实物。: When fighting for rare items, Tyrant seals off the outside circuit, and Raider is responsible for quick recovery of the goods.
报酬已交付，暴君仍要求掠夺者公开臣服，后者准备带货另寻买家。: Payment has been made, yet the Tyrant still demands the Raider's public submission; the Raider prepares to take the goods to another buyer.
暴君离开王座，把唯一按钮锁进盒中；掠夺者放下那半件稀有物，两人只带各自的一半去看: The Tyrant leaves the throne and locks the sole control button in a box. The Raider sets down that half of the rare object, and they take only their own halves with them to watch the sunrise.
稀有物原来能解除暴君的控制，两人忽然都需要对方自愿交出手中那一半。: The rare object turns out to be capable of breaking the Tyrant's Control, and suddenly each needs the other to surrender their half voluntarily.
解除封锁与臣服要求，双方在见证下交换等值物并保留退出权。: Lift the blockade and the demand for submission; have both sides exchange items of equal value before witnesses while retaining the right to leave.
两份追缴令都盖完章，最后一页却各自写着对方。: Both recovery orders bear their seals, yet each names the other on its final page.
两人同为利压惩饰，既要实际收益，也可能以程序继续惩罚不配合者；差异来自一人掌握旧: Both combine Gain, Pressure, Punitive harm, and Justification. They seek material returns and may use procedure to keep punishing those who refuse to cooperate. One controls the old case files and the other the enforcement register, allowing each to legitimize a pursuit of the other.
持卷者觉得对方执行利落，却总想把自己的疏漏也列成罪名。: The keeper of the files respects the other's efficient enforcement, but sees a constant urge to turn every oversight into an offense.
执表者认为对方证据齐全，但拿旧功抵新账的做法不能接受。: The keeper of the register finds the other's evidence thorough, but cannot accept using past merits to offset a new debt.
清理一笔多年坏账时，一人梳理证据链，一人按顺序冻结相关资产。: While resolving a years-old bad debt, one traces the chain of evidence and the other freezes the relevant assets in sequence.
追回金额已经足够，两人却争论谁曾拖延，开始互开追加责任清单。: Enough has already been recovered, but they argue over who caused the delay and begin issuing each other new lists of liabilities.
两人同时在结案页盖章，又各自划掉对方名字后的附注；锁好卷柜后，他们交换钥匙去赶末: They stamp the closing page together, and each strikes out the note beside the other's name. After locking the file cabinet, they exchange keys and hurry for the last bus.
关键证据显示损失来自共同误判，谁先承认就等于放下惩罚优势。: Crucial evidence shows that the loss arose from a shared misjudgment; whoever admits it first gives up their punitive advantage.
共同签署结案页、撤销对彼此的追加清单，并归还无关物品。: Sign the closing page together, withdraw the additional claims against each other, and return unrelated property.
文书刚宣布没收完毕，摊架又被一脚踢出清单。: The order has barely declared the confiscation complete when a kick sends a market stall beyond the limits of the list.
两人共享利、压、惩，都可能在取得利益后仍让反抗者付代价；清算者依赖饰端的程序说明: Both favor Gain, Pressure, and Punitive harm, and may keep making resisters pay even after securing the benefit. The Collector relies on procedural Justification; the Bruiser favors Disregard, using open aggression itself as a deterrent.
清算者觉得悍客能震住现场，却总把可辩护的惩罚变成明显泄愤。: The Collector thinks the Bruiser can intimidate everyone present, but always turns defensible punishment into obvious venting.
悍客认为清算者躲在纸后面，明明要压人却不肯直说。: The Bruiser thinks the Collector hides behind paperwork, unwilling to admit openly to putting people under Pressure.
整顿一处黑市时，清算者列出处置范围，悍客守住出口阻止转移货物。: While shutting down a black market, the Collector defines the scope of enforcement and the Bruiser guards the exit to prevent goods from being moved.
悍客砸毁未列入没收的设备，清算者发现自己的程序外衣被当场撕破。: The Bruiser smashes equipment that was not listed for confiscation, stripping away the Collector's procedural cover on the spot.
悍客扶起清单外倒掉的摊架，清算者递来修补用的钉子；店主离开后，两人仍自愿留下把棚: The Bruiser rights the stall toppled beyond the list, and the Collector hands over nails for the repair. After the owner leaves, they choose to stay and finish mending the roof.
围观者开始记录全过程，两人对公开形象的需求差异突然放大。: Onlookers begin recording the entire scene, suddenly magnifying the difference in how much each cares about public appearances.
悍客停止破坏并赔偿越界部分，清算者公布并锁死处置边界。: The Bruiser stops the destruction and pays for the harm beyond the agreed limits; the Collector publishes and fixes the boundaries of enforcement.
一个追究每次拒签，一个早已安排好谁会拒签。: One pursues every refusal to sign; the other has already arranged who will refuse.
双方共享饰端，会让行动拥有可公开说明；清算者偏利压惩，以程序追回并处罚，操盘手偏: Both favor Justification, ensuring their actions can be explained in public. The Collector leans toward Gain, Pressure, and Punitive harm, using procedure to recover losses and impose penalties. The Puppet Master leans toward Control, Strategy, and Instrumental harm, caring more that events follow the design and willing to stop once the objective is met.
清算者怀疑操盘手故意留下违约者，好让自己替他完成后续清场。: Collector suspects that Puppet Master deliberately left behind the defaulter so that he could finish his subsequent liquidation.
操盘手把清算者当成稳定后手，却担心其追加追责破坏可用关系。: The Puppet Master sees the Collector as a reliable fallback, but fears that further pursuit will destroy useful relationships.
重组一项合作时，操盘手安排退出次序，清算者按合同收回被占资源。: In reorganization of a cooperation, Puppet Master arranged for withdrawal and Collector recovered the occupied resources as contracted.
操盘手想保留一名曾违约的关键人，清算者坚持处罚必须一致落地。: The Puppet Master wants to retain a key person who once breached the agreement; the Collector insists that penalties must be applied consistently.
操盘手摊开全部指令记录，清算者在最后一页写下“到此为止”；两人合上卷宗，改走没有: The Puppet Master lays out the complete record of instructions, and the Collector writes “This ends here” on the final page. They close the file and take a path with no seating order arranged in advance.
关键人拿出操盘手授意违约的证据，执行者突然成了被利用的一环。: The key person produces evidence that the Puppet Master instructed the breach, revealing that the enforcer was another link in the manipulation.
暂停追责、公开全部指令记录，并让受影响者重新选择是否合作。: Pause the pursuit of responsibility, disclose the complete record of instructions, and let those affected choose again whether to cooperate.
一张罚单本想结束争议，却被扩音器念成了开战宣言。: A ticket that tried to end the dispute was read by the loudspeaker as a declaration of war.
两人共享惩端，可能把挑战者付出代价视作独立目标；清算者以利压饰走程序追缴，煽动家: Both favor Punitive harm and may treat making a challenger pay as an objective in itself. The Collector uses Gain, Pressure, and Justification to pursue recovery through procedure; the Agitator uses Control, Strategy, and Disregard to mobilize factions. Their disputes often shift from verifiable facts to public allegiance.
清算者觉得煽动家擅长聚焦冒犯，却会把可核对的案件烧成口号。: The Collector thinks the Agitator is skilled at focusing attention on an offense, but turns a verifiable case into slogans.
煽动家认为清算者的罚单是绝佳火种，只是语气过于无聊。: The Agitator sees the Collector's penalty notice as perfect kindling, though its tone is far too dull.
揭露一场侵占时，清算者整理追责清单，煽动家让公众注意到被掩盖的损失。: While exposing a case of misappropriation, the Collector compiles a list of liabilities and the Agitator draws public attention to the concealed losses.
煽动家点名无关者来维持声势，清算者拒绝把未证实的人写进处罚。: The Agitator names uninvolved people to sustain momentum; the Collector refuses to add anyone unverified to the penalty list.
煽动家关掉麦克风，清算者收起罚单，两人一起把夸大的海报换成核实数字；贴完最后一张: The Agitator switches off the microphone and the Collector puts away the notices. Together they replace exaggerated posters with verified figures; after hanging the last one, each decides independently whether to stay or leave.
被声讨者承认错误并补偿，是否继续动员成为两人关系的分界线。: The target of the campaign admits the wrongdoing and provides compensation; whether to keep mobilizing becomes the dividing line between them.
停止点名扩散，公布已核实范围，并确认补偿完成后关闭追责入口。: Stop spreading names, publish the verified scope, and close the channel for further pursuit once compensation is confirmed complete.
一个负责执行判决，一个负责让判决永远对自己有利。: One enforces the ruling; the other ensures every ruling works in their own favor.
两人共享惩与饰，可能借程序外观处罚冒犯者；清算者偏利压，注重追回具体损失并直接执: Both favor Punitive harm and Justification, and may use a procedural facade to punish those who offend them. The Collector leans toward Gain and Pressure, focusing on recovering concrete losses through direct enforcement. The Power Broker leans toward Control and Strategy, caring more about retaining the right to judge and their position within the faction.
清算者尊重权术家的判席，却逐渐发现同类案件总有两种尺度。: The Collector respects the Power Broker's seat on the bench, but gradually discovers that similar cases are judged by two different standards.
权术家需要清算者让判决落地，也担心他按统一标准查到自己。: The Power Broker needs the Collector to enforce rulings, but fears that applying one standard consistently will eventually implicate the Power Broker.
处理内部舞弊时，权术家组织听证口径，清算者冻结收益并追回款项。: When handling internal fraud, the Power Broker controls the framing of the hearing while the Collector freezes the proceeds and recovers the funds.
证据指向权术家的盟友，清算者坚持照章执行，双方争夺谁定义例外。: The evidence points to the Power Broker's ally. The Collector insists on following the rules, and the two struggle over who gets to define an exception.
权术家把自己的评分牌也放进复核箱，清算者撕下已结清的欠条；两人轮流读出一条对自己: The Power Broker places their own scorecard in the review box, and the Collector tears up the settled debt note. They take turns reading aloud a record that reflects badly on themselves.
两份完全相反的旧判例同时出现，任何解释都会暴露一方曾经的选择。: Two entirely contrary old cases appear simultaneously, and any interpretation reveals the choice of one party.
引入独立复核，暂停执行，并承诺结果同样适用于双方盟友。: Introduce an independent review, pause enforcement, and commit to applying its outcome equally to both sides' allies.
离开的人不仅欠钱，还被宣布欠下整个共同体。: Those who left not only owed money but were also declared to owe the community as a whole.
两人共享惩端，可能在拒绝后继续追击；清算者以利压饰把代价写成程序与欠款，教主以权: Both favor Punitive harm and may keep pursuing someone after a refusal. The Collector uses Gain, Pressure, and Justification to frame the cost as procedure and debt; the Cult Leader uses Control, Strategy, and Disregard to recast departure as betrayal. They are pursuing different kinds of debt.
清算者认为教主能制造强约束，却把无法计量的忠诚也列入欠账。: Collector considered that Cult Leader could create strong constraints, but included unquantifiable loyalty in the debt.
教主觉得清算者只追财物，没理解退出者动摇的是整个归属秩序。: The Cult Leader thinks the Collector pursues only property and fails to understand that those who leave destabilize the entire order of belonging.
社群分裂后，教主维持核心成员，清算者追回被带走的共同资产。: After the community split, Cult Leader maintained its core membership and Collector recovered the assets taken from the community.
财物已悉数归还，教主仍要求公开忏悔，清算者质疑继续行动的收益。: The property was returned in full, Cult Leader still demanded public confession, and Collector questioned the proceeds of the continued operation.
教主打开出口，清算者把已还清的欠单撕掉；人群散尽后，两人仍回来搬走最后一排空椅子: The Cult Leader opens the exit, and the Collector tears up the settled debt note. After the crowd disperses, they still return together to carry away the last row of empty chairs.
一名被定为异端的人救下共同项目，两人必须重算功过与归属。: Someone branded a heretic saves their shared project, forcing both to reassess merit, fault, and belonging.
确认财物结清，停止公开追击，并撤回对离开者的连带限制。: Confirm that all property has been settled, stop the public pursuit, and withdraw restrictions imposed on others because someone left.
一个要求把损失补齐，一个要求补齐时队列仍不能乱。: One demands that the loss be repaid in full; the other demands that the queue remain orderly throughout repayment.
两人共享压与饰，偏好明确规则和公开可辩护的强制；清算者以利惩追偿并处罚，铁腕者以: Both favor Pressure and Justification, preferring explicit rules and publicly defensible coercion. The Collector uses Gain and Punitive harm to recover losses and impose penalties; the Enforcer uses Control and Instrumental harm to maintain orders, and may stop escalating once order is restored.
清算者觉得铁腕者重纪律却轻旧账，服从恢复不代表代价付清。: The Collector thinks the Enforcer values discipline but neglects old debts: restored obedience does not mean the price has been paid.
铁腕者认为清算者追得太久，持续处罚反而妨碍队伍重新运转。: The Enforcer thinks the Collector pursues matters for too long, with continued punishment preventing the group from functioning again.
物资失窃后，铁腕者封锁现场和权限，清算者核算损失并制定返还次序。: After supplies are stolen, the Enforcer locks down the site and access permissions while the Collector calculates the loss and sets the order of restitution.
责任人服从新规但无力全额赔付，两人对恢复秩序还是继续追偿意见相反。: The responsible person follows the new rules but cannot repay the full amount. The two disagree over whether to restore order or continue pursuing repayment.
夜班交接时，清算者在补偿表末尾画下句号，铁腕者把解除令夹在第一页；两人给彼此留了: At the night-shift handover, the Collector draws a period at the end of the compensation form, and the Enforcer slips the release order into its first page. Each leaves the other a cup of hot water.
新的紧急任务必须启用被处罚者，旧账与当前秩序第一次正面冲突。: A new emergency requires bringing the punished person back into service, putting the old debt and present order into direct conflict for the first time.
写明补偿上限和完成日期，到点停止处分并恢复必要权限。: Set a cap and completion date for compensation; end the sanctions on that date and restore the necessary access.
一份清算报告摆上桌，只换来一句“到此为止”。: A recovery report lands on the table and receives only one reply: “This ends here.”
两人共享压端，能直接执行决定；清算者以利惩饰追求损失与冒犯都被处理，定局者以权用: Both favor Pressure and can enforce decisions directly. The Collector combines Gain, Punitive harm, and Justification, seeking redress for both loss and offense. The Decider combines Control, Instrumental harm, and Disregard, prioritizing personal authority and willing to stop adding punishment once the objective is achieved.
清算者认为定局者的停手太随意，未支付的代价会变成下一次冒犯。: The Collector considers the Decider's decision to stop too arbitrary, fearing an unpaid price will invite the next offense.
定局者觉得清算者拿旧账绑住当前决定，不允许局面由自己翻篇。: The Decider thinks the Collector is using old debts to constrain the present decision and denying the Decider the power to turn the page.
并购混乱中，定局者拍板切断旧合作，清算者按协议回收资产与欠款。: Amid the chaos of a merger, the Decider decides to sever the old partnership while the Collector recovers assets and debts under the agreement.
定局者为迅速建立新秩序豁免关键人，清算者坚持例外会损害全部追偿。: To establish a new order quickly, the Decider exempts a key person; the Collector insists that the exception will undermine the entire recovery effort.
定局者没有驳回那份追偿报告，只把自己的例外也添进去；清算者核完最后一笔，邀请他共: The Decider does not reject the recovery report, but adds their own exception to it. After checking the final entry, the Collector invites the Decider to sign the closing date together.
被豁免者带来唯一救急资源，原则和现实不再各自站在一人那边。: The exempted person brings the only emergency resource, so principle and practical necessity no longer line up neatly behind one person each.
双方列明豁免的范围与补偿，由受影响者确认后正式结案。: Have both sides specify the scope of the exemption and the compensation, then formally close the case once those affected confirm the terms.
一个要在卷宗里留下罪名，一个要连卷宗本身一起消失。: One wants an accusation preserved in the case file. The other wants the entire file to disappear.
两人共享压、惩、饰，都可能借制度形式持续处置挑战；清算者优先追回利益并留下可结算: Both combine Pressure, Punitive intent and Justification, and may use institutional procedures to keep punishing challenges. The Collector prioritizes recovering gains and keeping a record that can be settled; the Arbiter prioritizes control and obedience, even closing off ways to object.
清算者认为裁决者删档会破坏追责依据，也可能遮住真正的欠款。: The Collector thinks the Arbiter's deletions undermine accountability and may conceal what is actually owed.
裁决者觉得清算者保留太多记录，让异议者仍有翻案与发声空间。: The Arbiter thinks the Collector keeps too many records, leaving dissenters room to appeal and speak out.
处理内部泄密时，清算者追查获利链，裁决者关闭权限并执行纪律处分。: Investigating an internal leak, the Collector traces who profited while the Arbiter revokes access and imposes disciplinary action.
追回损失后，裁决者要求抹掉相关人的全部成果，清算者认为无法核账。: After the losses are recovered, the Arbiter demands that all the person's work be erased. The Collector objects that the accounts can no longer be checked.
裁决者从碎纸堆里拼回异议页，清算者在卷宗封面写明不再追罚；两人把原件送回档案架，: The Arbiter pieces a page of objections back together from the shredded pile. The Collector marks the file as closed to further penalties. They return the original to the archive and keep a copy for each other.
唯一能证明双方清白的材料，正是裁决者命令销毁的那份记录。: The only material that could clear them both is the very record the Arbiter ordered destroyed.
停止删档和追罚，恢复原件，并将证据副本交给独立见证者。: Stop deleting records and adding penalties, restore the originals and give copies of the evidence to an independent witness.
一个坚持每项惩罚都有卷宗，一个宣布王座本身就是理由。: One insists that every punishment needs a case file. The other declares that the throne is reason enough.
两人共享压与惩，会直接收窄选择并可能在目标后追加代价；清算者以利饰追求可记录的追: Both use direct constraints and may add penalties after achieving their goal. The Collector seeks documented compensation, combining Gain with Justification. The Tyrant combines Control with Disregard, treating personal will as final without needing outside approval.
清算者畏惧暴君改写终审结果，因为再完整的账也挡不住一句特赦。: The Collector fears the Tyrant can rewrite a final ruling: even perfect accounts cannot withstand a sudden pardon.
暴君欣赏清算者冷静执行，却厌烦他总为自己的决定寻找程序边界。: The Tyrant appreciates the Collector's calm execution but resents the constant search for procedural limits on a decision.
战后处置中，暴君指定必须回收的资源，清算者组织逐项追偿与登记。: In the aftermath of a war, the Tyrant identifies resources to recover. The Collector organizes compensation and records each item.
清算者宣布赔偿完成应当结案，暴君仍要处罚曾拒绝宣誓的人。: The Collector declares compensation complete and the case ready to close. The Tyrant still wants to punish those who refused an oath of loyalty.
暴君把按钮罩上透明盒，清算者给旧账盖下结案章；黄昏里，两人把钥匙交给第三人后并肩: The Tyrant places a transparent cover over the button; the Collector stamps the old account closed. At dusk, they hand the key to a third person and leave the court together.
暴君的亲信出现在追偿名单上，程序与最终意志被迫公开碰撞。: One of the Tyrant's favorites appears on the compensation list, forcing procedure and personal will into a public confrontation.
冻结终审按钮，由独立席复核名单，并确认赔偿完成即停止惩罚。: Disable the final-ruling button, have an independent panel review the list and agree that punishment ends when compensation is complete.
两脚同时踢向对方的摊架，钱袋反倒滚到了路中央。: Both kick at the other's stall, while the money bag rolls into the middle of the road.
两人同为利压惩蔑，既要资源，也可能公开追加代价逼对方认输；差异由一方先占街口、一: Both combine Gain, Pressure, Punitive intent and Disregard: they want resources and may publicly impose extra costs to force a concession. One controls the street corner while the other brings the customers. Strength alone does not decide who has more bargaining power.
占街口者觉得对方抢自己的地盘，却离不开那批会回来的人。: The one holding the corner sees a rival taking over the territory, but still needs the other's returning customers.
握客源者把对方看成粗暴门槛，也知道绕路会失去最好位置。: The one bringing customers sees the other as an aggressive gatekeeper, while knowing that taking another route would mean losing the best location.
外来竞争者压价时，两人暂时合摊，一人守入口、一人锁住供货。: When an outside competitor undercuts their prices, they briefly join stalls: one guards the entrance while the other secures the supply.
客流恢复后，双方都要求对方为旧日挑衅额外让出一块位置。: Once customers return, each demands another piece of space as compensation for the other's earlier provocations.
两人把彼此踢歪的摊架一一扶正，最后一只钱袋放回路中央；谁都没伸手抢，却同时递出一: They straighten the stalls they kicked over and return the last money bag to the middle of the road. Neither reaches to grab it. Instead, both offer a new sign.
滚走的钱袋被第三人捡起，继续争胜意味着双方同时失去实际收益。: A third person picks up the runaway money bag. Keeping the fight going would cost them both the actual gains.
扶正彼此摊架、归还钱袋，并各退回划定边界一步之外。: Repair each other's stalls, return the money bags and each step back beyond the agreed boundary.
一个把桌子掀翻，一个已经安排好谁来收拾残局。: One overturns the table. The other has already arranged who will clean up.
两人目标、手段与规范策略不同：悍客偏利压惩蔑，可能在强索后追加代价；操盘手偏权谋: Their goals, methods and use of norms differ. The Bruiser favors Gain, Pressure, Punitive intent and Disregard, and may add costs after an aggressive demand. The Puppet Master favors Control, Strategy, Instrumental action and Justification, designing the options while maintaining a defensible appearance. Cooperation needs a separate shared task.
悍客觉得操盘手躲在幕后，却能让自己每次掀桌都掀在要害。: The Bruiser thinks the Puppet Master hides backstage, yet somehow makes every disruption land where it matters most.
操盘手把悍客视作制造转折的重锤，也怕他砸坏计划仍要保留的人。: The Puppet Master sees the Bruiser as a powerful way to force a turning point, but fears harm to people the plan still needs.
谈判僵局中，操盘手安排替代席位，悍客以一次公开闯入迫使对手重谈。: During a stalled negotiation, the Puppet Master arranges alternative seats at the table. The Bruiser's public interruption forces the other side to negotiate again.
对手已经让步，悍客仍追打旧辱，操盘手精心维持的后续联盟濒临破裂。: The other side has already conceded, but the Bruiser keeps pursuing an old insult. The Puppet Master's carefully maintained future alliance is close to collapse.
操盘手解开最后一根控制线，悍客把掀翻的桌子扶回原位；没有观众安排座次时，两人自己: The Puppet Master releases the last control string. The Bruiser puts the overturned table back. With no audience arranging the seating, they pull up their own chairs.
被当成棋子的人拒绝收拾残局，幕后者与掀桌者同时失去熟悉支点。: The person treated as a pawn refuses to clean up, leaving both the backstage planner and the disruptor without their familiar support.
悍客赔回损坏物，操盘手公开幕后安排并让相关人自由退出。: The Bruiser pays for the damage. The Puppet Master reveals the hidden arrangements and lets everyone involved leave freely.
扩音器把怒气推向全场，拳头只需选中一个方向。: The megaphone fills the room with anger. The fist only has to choose a direction.
双方共享惩与蔑，可能不靠体面解释并延续对冒犯者的代价；悍客偏利压，以直接威慑索取: Both share Punitive intent and Disregard: they may dispense with respectable explanations and keep imposing costs on those who offend them. The Bruiser uses Gain and Pressure to demand resources through direct intimidation. The Agitator uses Control and Strategy to rearrange the situation through emotions and opposing camps.
悍客欣赏煽动家替自己指出目标，却不愿永远给人群当表演道具。: The Bruiser likes having the Agitator point out a target, but does not want to be a prop for the crowd forever.
煽动家觉得悍客能把口号变成现实威胁，也会粗暴抢走舞台中心。: The Agitator thinks the Bruiser can turn slogans into a real threat, but can also forcefully take center stage.
争夺社团场地时，煽动家召集支持者造势，悍客堵住门口逼管理者回应。: Competing for a club venue, the Agitator rallies supporters while the Bruiser blocks the entrance to force a response from its manager.
场地已到手，煽动家仍需要敌人维持阵营，悍客则要求优先分配实际收益。: The venue is secured, but the Agitator still needs an enemy to hold the group together. The Bruiser wants the practical benefits divided first.
煽动家收起扩音器，悍客把堵门的凳子搬开；两人卷起同一幅旧横幅，在空场里商量下一站: The Agitator puts away the megaphone. The Bruiser moves the stool blocking the door. They roll up the same old banner and discuss their next destination in the empty venue.
支持者开始同情被针对的人，原本互相放大的攻击突然反噬中心。: Supporters begin to sympathize with the target. The attacks that once amplified each other suddenly turn back on their organizers.
停止点名与堵门，公开撤回威胁，并让被卷入者安全离场。: Stop singling people out and blocking the entrance, publicly withdraw the threats and let those drawn into the conflict leave safely.
台下有人逼对手认输，台上有人悄悄换了计分牌。: Someone outside the ring forces the opponent to concede. Someone inside quietly changes the scorecard.
两人共享惩端，可能为挑战者的代价继续投入；悍客以利压蔑直接索取并公开威慑，权术家: Both share Punitive intent and may keep investing in making a challenger pay. The Bruiser combines Gain, Pressure and Disregard to demand resources and intimidate openly. The Power Broker combines Control, Strategy and Justification to manipulate rulings while retaining respectability and authority.
悍客看不起暗改分数的做法，却需要那块牌证明自己一直在赢。: The Bruiser looks down on secretly changing scores, yet needs the scoreboard to prove an unbroken winning streak.
权术家把悍客当成场外压力，也担心他不接受任何对自己不利的安排。: The Power Broker uses the Bruiser as pressure from outside the contest, but worries the Bruiser will reject any arrangement that works against personal interests.
一场选拔中，权术家控制评分解释，悍客压迫竞争者退出关键回合。: During a selection contest, the Power Broker controls how scores are interpreted while the Bruiser pressures competitors to withdraw from a crucial round.
权术家把高分给了更听话的人，悍客认为自己出力却没拿到应得资源。: The Power Broker gives the high score to someone more compliant. The Bruiser believes that all the effort has failed to secure the resources deserved.
权术家把0分和10分牌一起扣下，悍客也退到拳台线外；散场后，他们各递一只手套，约: The Power Broker turns both the zero and ten scorecards face down. The Bruiser steps outside the ring. After everyone leaves, each offers a glove and they agree to decide the terms of the next match together.
完整录像公开了场内外操作，谁承担责任将决定两人是共保还是互揭。: A full recording exposes the actions inside and outside the ring. Who takes responsibility will determine whether they protect or expose each other.
恢复原始计分、解除退出压力，并接受一次公开而独立的重赛。: Restore the original scores, remove the pressure to withdraw and accept a public rematch with independent oversight.
门内门外组: Outside the Door, Inside the Group
一个在门口收走贡品，一个在门内收走离开的念头。: One collects offerings at the door. The other takes away the idea of leaving.
双方共享惩与蔑，对主流认可依赖较低，也可能追罚拒绝；悍客偏利压，直接索取实物并威: Both share Punitive intent and Disregard: they rely less on mainstream approval and may punish refusal. The Bruiser combines Gain and Pressure to demand material goods and intimidate directly. The Cult Leader combines Control and Strategy, using stories of belonging and group divisions to secure obedience.
悍客觉得教主的话能让人主动交东西，却受不了自己也被要求相信。: The Bruiser admires how the Cult Leader's words make people hand things over willingly, but resents being expected to believe as well.
教主把悍客当作守门力量，也担心他只认贡品、不认共同身份。: The Cult Leader sees the Bruiser as a gatekeeper, but worries that offerings matter more to the Bruiser than any shared identity.
封闭据点里，教主维持成员投入，悍客控制入口并收取被承诺的资源。: Inside a closed community, the Cult Leader sustains members' commitment. The Bruiser controls the entrance and collects the resources they were promised.
悍客公开私吞一份贡品，教主把这视为对精神中心和最终归属的挑战。: The Bruiser openly keeps an offering for personal use. The Cult Leader treats this as a challenge to the group's central authority and ultimate allegiance.
教主亲手打开侧门，悍客把门口收来的私人物品逐一归还；人群自由离开后，两人仍选择一: The Cult Leader opens the side door personally. The Bruiser returns the belongings collected at the entrance, one by one. Once everyone can leave freely, the two still choose to tidy the empty space together.
门外出现可自由生活的新去处，成员的选择让两人第一次失去共同控制物。: A new place offering a freer life opens outside. Members' choices leave the two without a shared means of control for the first time.
打开出口、返还私人贡品，并明确任何人离开都不遭追罚。: Open the exits, return people's personal offerings and make it explicit that leaving will carry no further punishment.
一个靠踢翻摊架立威，一个要求连立威也按队列进行。: One establishes dominance by kicking over stalls. The other insists even a show of dominance must follow an orderly line.
两人共享压端，会直接建立后果；悍客以利惩蔑索取并追加羞辱，铁腕者以权用饰维持命令: Both share Pressure and directly establish consequences. The Bruiser combines Gain, Punitive intent and Disregard to demand resources and add humiliation. The Enforcer combines Control, Instrumental action and Justification to maintain commands and order, and is more likely to stop once order is restored.
悍客觉得铁腕者规矩太多，却承认他能让整条街按一个节奏行动。: The Bruiser thinks the Enforcer has too many rules, yet admits they can make the entire street move to one rhythm.
铁腕者认为悍客有威慑力，但报复性破坏会侵蚀命令的正当外观。: The Enforcer sees the Bruiser's deterrent power, but thinks destructive retaliation undermines the apparent legitimacy of the orders.
混乱撤场中，铁腕者划定搬运次序，悍客用身体占位阻止插队抢货。: During a chaotic evacuation, the Enforcer sets the loading order while the Bruiser physically blocks anyone trying to jump the queue and seize supplies.
秩序已恢复，悍客仍要揪出先前挑衅者，铁腕者命令立即归队。: Order has returned, but the Bruiser still wants to find an earlier provocateur. The Enforcer orders an immediate return to the group.
撤离哨响，悍客收回追人的脚，铁腕者把备用路线交给他选择；最后一车开出时，两人隔窗: The evacuation signal sounds. The Bruiser stops pursuing someone; the Enforcer offers a choice of backup route. As the last vehicle leaves, they exchange a fist bump through the window.
紧急广播与私人旧怨同时出现，悍客必须选择追人还是执行共同撤离。: An emergency announcement arrives just as an old personal grievance resurfaces. The Bruiser must choose between pursuing someone and joining the shared evacuation.
悍客放下旧怨归队，铁腕者承诺事后只处理实际损失、不追加羞辱。: The Bruiser lets go of the grievance and rejoins the group. The Enforcer promises to address only actual losses afterward, without adding humiliation.
一个把路口当成收入，一个把路口当成决定权，盖下的章却压在同一张地图上。: One sees the junction as income. The other sees it as decision power. Both stamps land on the same map.
双方共享压与蔑，较少依赖规范认同，倾向直接让选择收窄；悍客要利益且可能惩罚反抗，: Both share Pressure and Disregard, relying less on approval from shared norms and tending to narrow choices directly. The Bruiser wants gains and may punish resistance; the Decider wants decision power but can stop once the command's objective is reached.
悍客认为定局者的命令能放大地盘，却不接受自己只能做被调用的拳头。: The Bruiser thinks the Decider's orders can expand the territory, but refuses to become a fist that moves only when summoned.
定局者欣赏悍客敢占街，但无法容忍他把私人收益放在统一决定之前。: The Decider admires the Bruiser's willingness to take the street, but cannot tolerate private gains taking priority over a unified decision.
争夺运输线时，定局者确定封路时段，悍客占住关键路口索取通行资源。: Competing for a transport route, the Decider sets road-closure periods while the Bruiser holds a key junction and demands resources for passage.
定局者宣布免费放行以展示权威，悍客失去收费收益并公开挑战决定。: The Decider declares free passage as a display of authority. The Bruiser loses toll income and openly challenges the decision.
定局者撤下单方封令，悍客搬开私人路障；空路口上，他们把地图铺在车盖，各圈一条愿意: The Decider withdraws the unilateral closure order. The Bruiser removes the private roadblock. At the empty junction, they spread the map across a car hood and each circle a route they would willingly share.
另一条路突然开放，原先的地盘和命令都彻底失去稀缺性。: Another route suddenly opens, making their territory and orders much less valuable as bottlenecks.
撤除私人路障与单方封令，由双方重新约定通行规则和期限。: Remove the private roadblocks and unilateral closure orders, then jointly agree on rules and time limits for passage.
一个砸掉说话的桌子，一个把说过的话从记录里抹掉。: One smashes the table where people speak. The other erases what was said from the record.
两人共享压与惩，可能直接压制并追罚挑战；悍客以利蔑公开威吓、索取实物，裁决者以权: Both share Pressure and Punitive intent, and may directly suppress and punish challenges. The Bruiser uses Gain and Disregard to threaten openly and demand material goods. The Arbiter uses Control and Justification to remove dissent quietly through institutions. Their visible and hidden methods create tension.
悍客嫌裁决者躲着动手，却承认无声清除能让反抗找不到出口。: The Bruiser dislikes the Arbiter's hidden actions, but admits that quiet removal can leave resistance with nowhere to turn.
裁决者认为悍客过于显眼，每次砸场都给异议留下可传播的画面。: The Arbiter thinks the Bruiser is too conspicuous: every public disruption gives dissenters images they can circulate.
压下一场抵制时，悍客占领活动现场，裁决者关闭账号与组织权限。: To suppress a boycott, the Bruiser occupies the event site while the Arbiter closes accounts and revokes organizing permissions.
悍客想公开羞辱领头者，裁决者坚持让事件无声消失，争夺惩罚的呈现方式。: The Bruiser wants to humiliate the leader publicly. The Arbiter insists the incident should disappear quietly. They struggle over how punishment should be seen.
裁决者恢复被删的录音，悍客用胶带粘好砸裂的话筒；播放到分歧处，两人都没有伸手按停: The Arbiter restores the deleted recording. The Bruiser tapes the broken microphone back together. When playback reaches their disagreement, neither reaches to stop it.
被删掉的发言由现场视频恢复，隐蔽与公开的行动被拼成同一证据链。: A recording from the event restores the deleted speech, connecting the hidden and public actions into one chain of evidence.
恢复发言权限、停止围堵，并由双方公开撤回对异议者的追加威胁。: Restore the right to speak, end the blockade and have both publicly withdraw additional threats against dissenters.
A已收下钱袋却仍要反抗者低头，B连低头的方式也要亲自决定。: A has already taken the money bag but still demands submission. B insists on personally deciding even how that submission must look.
两人同样偏压、惩、蔑，会直接收窄选择并可能为反抗追加代价；悍客优先具体利益，暴君: Both favor Pressure, Punitive intent and Disregard, narrowing choices directly and possibly adding costs for resistance. The Bruiser prioritizes concrete gains; the Tyrant prioritizes ultimate control. They can easily compete over the one position neither wants to share: who must concede to whom.
悍客把暴君看成更大的地盘主，却不愿交出自己收取的那一份。: The Bruiser sees the Tyrant as a bigger territorial boss, but will not surrender the share already collected.
暴君认为悍客只是局部强手，任何不经允许的威慑都是僭越。: The Tyrant sees the Bruiser as powerful only locally. Any intimidation carried out without permission is an overreach.
平定一片失控街区时，暴君下达最终禁令，悍客逐个压住资源入口。: Bringing an uncontrolled district to heel, the Tyrant issues a final ban while the Bruiser takes control of resource entrances one by one.
收益已经归拢，悍客拒绝公开臣服，暴君把这场拒绝看得比收益更重。: The gains have been gathered, but the Bruiser refuses to submit publicly. The Tyrant now cares more about that refusal than the gains.
暴君离开王座，把按钮钥匙放在两把椅子之间；悍客卸下堵门的锁链，两人各自坐下，也都: The Tyrant leaves the throne and puts the button's key between two chairs. The Bruiser removes the chain blocking the door. Each sits down, and either can stand up and leave at any time.
所有人同时撤离街区，两人的权势失去观众，只剩彼此是否愿意留下。: Everyone leaves the district at once. Their power has no audience left; only the question of whether either wants to stay with the other remains.
解除封锁和臣服要求，双方各归还一项越界取得的资源。: End the blockade and the demand for submission. Each returns one resource acquired by overstepping a boundary.
两只手各牵三根线，都以为另一只手也在自己的安排里。: Two hands each hold three strings, each assuming the other hand is part of its own arrangement.
两人同为权谋用饰，通过设计关系取得决定权，并在目标达成后维持体面收束；差异来自一: Both combine Control, Strategy, Instrumental action and Justification: they gain decision power by designing relationships and seek a respectable conclusion once the goal is reached. One starts with the network of people; the other controls the schedule and public story.
掌人脉者把对方视作精准调度者，却担心自己也只是时间表一格。: The one with the contacts sees a precise coordinator in the other, but worries about being only another slot in the schedule.
控节奏者欣赏对方能调动关键人，也想知道那些人最终听谁的。: The one controlling the timing appreciates the other's ability to mobilize key people, while wondering whom those people ultimately follow.
筹备一场跨城展演时，一人协调各方利益，一人错开进场与发布顺序。: Preparing a performance across several cities, one coordinates the parties' interests while the other staggers arrivals and announcements.
主办方只保留一个总负责人，两人开始悄悄让同一批盟友表态。: The organizer retains only one overall lead. Both quietly begin asking the same allies to choose a side.
排练结束后，两人交换各自藏着的时间表，只共同改动中间那一格；其余空白仍归本人，第: After rehearsal, they exchange the schedules each had kept hidden and change only the middle slot together. The remaining space belongs to its original owner. The next day, both still arrive on time.
原定主角临时缺席，两套备用方案同时启动，幕后重叠终于显形。: The scheduled lead performer suddenly cannot attend. Both backup plans launch at once, exposing the overlap behind the scenes.
交换完整排期与联系人清单，并共同指定一项不得私自改动的决定。: Exchange complete schedules and contact lists, and jointly identify one decision neither may change alone.
一个在幕后拨动人群，一个站上台让人群以为选择来自自己。: One steers the crowd from backstage. The other takes the stage and makes the crowd feel the choice was its own.
两人同为权谋用，偏向重排信息、关系与选择来控制局面，达到目的后可收束；操盘手偏饰: Both combine Control, Strategy and Instrumental action: they rearrange information, relationships and choices to steer a situation, and can stop once their purpose is achieved. The Puppet Master favors Justification and a defensible appearance. The Agitator favors Disregard and relies less on approval from shared norms.
操盘手把煽动家当作高能扩音器，也怕声浪越过预设边界。: The Puppet Master sees the Agitator as a powerful amplifier, but fears the message may travel beyond the planned boundaries.
煽动家知道操盘手给自己搭了台，却不愿永远照幕后脚本讲话。: The Agitator knows the Puppet Master built the stage, but does not want to speak from a backstage script forever.
在一次组织改选中，操盘手安排联盟顺序，煽动家用公开演说凝聚关键票。: During an organizational election, the Puppet Master arranges the sequence of alliances while the Agitator uses public speeches to bring together the crucial votes.
煽动家临场改口抢走议题中心，操盘手准备把支持者从台下逐步抽空。: The Agitator changes the message on the spot and takes control of the agenda. The Puppet Master prepares to quietly draw supporters away from the audience.
空剧场里，操盘手铺开座次图，煽动家写下开场第一句；他们留下几排自由席，也给彼此留: In an empty theater, the Puppet Master unfolds a seating plan and the Agitator writes the opening line. They leave several rows open to anyone and each allow the other one spontaneous change.
现场麦克风故障，煽动家只能直面小圈对话，操盘手也失去可操控的声量。: The microphone fails. The Agitator must speak directly with a small circle, while the Puppet Master loses the ability to control the message's reach.
双方公开共同目标，停止匿名带节奏，并让参与者重新自由表态。: State the shared goal openly, stop anonymously steering the discussion and let participants express their preferences freely again.
一个摆好所有座位，一个决定同一把椅子谁坐都算不同分。: One arranges every seat. The other gives the same chair a different score depending on who sits in it.
双方共享权谋饰，都可能借关系设计与体面程序维护决定权；操盘手偏用，局面稳定即可停: Both combine Control, Strategy and Justification, and may use designed relationships and respectable procedures to retain decision power. The Puppet Master favors Instrumental action and can stop once the situation is stable. The Power Broker favors Punitive intent and may use judgment to keep penalizing challengers.
操盘手欣赏权术家的裁定效力，却担心私人追罚损坏整个布局。: The Puppet Master appreciates the force of the Power Broker's rulings, but fears private retaliation will damage the whole arrangement.
权术家认为操盘手会布置可用位置，但不该由他决定谁免于处罚。: The Power Broker thinks the Puppet Master can arrange useful positions, but should not decide who escapes punishment.
董事会僵持时，操盘手组合表决联盟，权术家提供一套可公开通过的评判口径。: At a deadlocked board meeting, the Puppet Master assembles a voting coalition. The Power Broker supplies a publicly acceptable set of judging criteria.
操盘手保留一名曾反对过的人，权术家坚持将其排除以维护裁席威信。: The Puppet Master keeps someone who previously objected. The Power Broker insists on excluding them to protect the authority of the judging seat.
权术家把两块评分牌靠墙放下，操盘手收起控制杆；他们捡回落选的模型，按彼此认可的目: The Power Broker rests both scorecards against the wall. The Puppet Master puts away the control bar. They retrieve the rejected model and rebuild it around a goal they both accept.
被排除者握有救局方案，两人必须在承认错误与维持权位间选择。: The excluded person has the only plan that can save the situation. Both must choose between admitting a mistake and preserving their positions.
暂停裁定和席位调整，公开利益关系，并给被排除者完整陈述机会。: Pause the ruling and seat changes, disclose relevant interests and give the excluded person a full chance to speak.
一个安排所有路径汇向同一处，一个让来人相信只有这一处值得留下。: One makes every path lead to the same place. The other convinces newcomers that nowhere else is worth staying.
两人共享权谋，倾向重排选择与关系来取得主导；操盘手以用饰维持可辩护结构并止于局面: Both share Control and Strategy, reshaping choices and relationships to gain the lead. The Puppet Master combines Instrumental action and Justification, maintaining a defensible structure and stopping when the arrangement is established. The Cult Leader combines Punitive intent and Disregard in responding to departures, attaching further obligations to belonging itself.
操盘手觉得教主能让安排自行运转，却怕信念压过可调整的全局。: The Puppet Master thinks the Cult Leader can make an arrangement run on its own, but fears belief may override the flexibility of the wider plan.
