教主把操盘手视作幕后管家，也怀疑他只忠于布局而非共同信条。: The Cult Leader sees the Puppet Master as a backstage steward, but suspects loyalty to the arrangement rather than the shared beliefs.
建立新组织时，教主提供中心叙事，操盘手安排分工、盟友和对外合法外观。: When founding an organization, the Cult Leader provides its central story. The Puppet Master arranges roles, allies and a legitimate public appearance.
操盘手建议体面放走异议者，教主坚持退出必须被标记为背叛。: The Puppet Master proposes letting dissenters leave with dignity. The Cult Leader insists that leaving must be marked as betrayal.
教主打开礼堂侧门，操盘手撤掉通往舞台的引导线；散场后，两人各带一把椅子，在门外并: The Cult Leader opens the hall's side door. The Puppet Master removes the lines guiding everyone to the stage. After the gathering, each carries a chair outside and they watch dawn arrive together.
核心叙事被事实推翻，谁先修改路线就会动摇自己建立的权威来源。: Facts overturn the central story. Whichever person changes course first will unsettle the very source of authority they created.
开放无惩罚退出，公开组织分工，并停止对私人关系的后台干预。: Allow people to leave without punishment, make organizational roles public and stop hidden interference in personal relationships.
一个安排队伍为何转向，一个只需落闸让所有人必须转向。: One arranges the reasons a group turns. The other lowers a barrier so it has no other direction to go.
两人共享权、用、饰，重视决定权及可辩护外观，目标达成后可停止；操盘手偏谋，以关系: Both share Control, Instrumental action and Justification: they value decision power and a defensible appearance, and can stop when the goal is achieved. The Puppet Master uses Strategy to guide choices through relationships. The Enforcer uses Pressure to narrow choices directly through clear discipline.
操盘手把铁腕者视作稳定主轴，却担心硬命令破坏精细联盟。: The Puppet Master sees the Enforcer as a stable organizing force, but fears rigid orders will break delicate alliances.
铁腕者认可操盘手能预判阻力，但嫌多层安排让命令失去清晰来源。: The Enforcer appreciates the Puppet Master's ability to anticipate resistance, but thinks layers of arrangements obscure where orders come from.
大型迁移中，操盘手协调各队利益，铁腕者统一时刻、路线和应急纪律。: During a large relocation, the Puppet Master coordinates the teams' interests. The Enforcer sets shared times, routes and emergency procedures.
操盘手私下允许关键队伍绕行，铁腕者认为例外直接挑战统一指挥。: The Puppet Master privately lets a key team take a different route. The Enforcer sees the exception as a direct challenge to unified command.
主路线中断时，操盘手递出三张备用路线卡，铁腕者选了一张也留下另一张；两人在新路口: When the main route closes, the Puppet Master offers three backup route cards. The Enforcer chooses one and keeps another available. At the new junction, they exchange the keys for their watch shifts.
主路线突发中断，后台备用安排必须依靠前台命令才能救下全队。: The main route unexpectedly fails. The hidden backup arrangements now need explicit orders to save the whole group.
公开备用路线，由铁腕者宣布一次共同修订，并停止追究善意绕行。: Make the backup routes public, have the Enforcer announce a jointly agreed revision and stop pursuing penalties for good-faith detours.
一个让所有意见恰好汇成结论，一个把结论盖成自己的决定。: One makes every opinion converge neatly on a conclusion. The other stamps that conclusion as a personal decision.
两人共享权与用，目标是局面由自己主导且可在结果形成后收束；操盘手偏谋饰，通过安排: Both share Control and Instrumental action: they want to lead the situation and can stop once the result is in place. The Puppet Master combines Strategy and Justification, working through arrangements and explanations. The Decider combines Pressure and Disregard, ending negotiation through a personal decision.
操盘手觉得定局者的印章省掉很多铺垫，却会夺走安排者应有的控制。: The Puppet Master thinks the Decider's stamp saves much groundwork, but takes control away from the person who arranged everything.
定局者认为操盘手能预处理阻力，但幕后影响不能凌驾自己的最终拍板。: The Decider thinks the Puppet Master can deal with resistance in advance, but backstage influence must never overrule the final decision.
推动高争议方案时，操盘手先拆分反对联盟，定局者随后公开宣布统一决定。: To push through a controversial plan, the Puppet Master first breaks apart the opposing coalition. The Decider then publicly announces a single decision.
定局者临时改结论展示独断权，操盘手此前交换出去的承诺全部失效。: The Decider changes the conclusion at the last moment to demonstrate sole authority, invalidating every promise the Puppet Master had negotiated.
定局者把印章留在未完成的计划旁，操盘手摊开没有预设终点的地图；两人轮流画一站，随: The Decider leaves the stamp beside an unfinished plan. The Puppet Master opens a map with no predetermined endpoint. They take turns drawing the next stop, with room to turn back whenever they choose.
所有人都同意方案后却拒绝承认定局者功劳，决定权与实际结果突然分离。: Everyone agrees to the plan but refuses to give the Decider credit. Decision power and the practical result suddenly come apart.
撤回临时改令，公开前置协商，并把最终选择交给约定的共同程序。: Withdraw the last-minute order change, disclose the earlier negotiations and return the final choice to an agreed joint process.
一个把异议安排到边缘，一个直接让那张椅子从名单消失。: One pushes dissent to the edge of the room. The other removes the chair from the list altogether.
双方共享权与饰，会维护可辩护的控制结构；操盘手偏谋用，通过关系重排达成局面即可，: Both share Control and Justification and maintain a defensible structure of authority. The Puppet Master uses Strategy and Instrumental action, rearranging relationships until the desired situation is established. The Arbiter uses Pressure and Punitive intent, imposing continuing institutional costs on open dissent.
操盘手认为裁决者删得太彻底，使原本可转化的人脉变成永久敌人。: The Puppet Master thinks the Arbiter erases too much, turning people who might have become allies into permanent enemies.
裁决者觉得操盘手保留异议只是养患，也怀疑他借复杂布局藏责任。: The Arbiter thinks the Puppet Master's tolerance of dissent only stores up trouble, and suspects the complicated arrangements hide responsibility.
重组敏感部门时，操盘手调整关系与岗位，裁决者执行权限收回和纪律隔离。: When restructuring a sensitive department, the Puppet Master rearranges relationships and roles. The Arbiter revokes access and imposes disciplinary separation.
操盘手私留一条沟通暗线，裁决者发现后把它视为对统一控制的背叛。: The Puppet Master secretly retains a communication channel. On discovering it, the Arbiter treats it as a betrayal of unified control.
裁决者把删除的席位重新写回名单，操盘手拆掉绕过那把椅子的暗线；会后，两人各留一张: The Arbiter restores the deleted seat to the list. The Puppet Master removes the secret channel that bypassed it. After the meeting, each leaves the other a note that requires no reply.
被删除席位的人掌握唯一修复方案，消失的接口必须由两人亲手恢复。: The person whose seat was erased has the only workable repair plan. Both must personally restore the missing connection.
恢复席位和通信权限，披露暗线用途，并停止追加纪律处分。: Restore the seat and communication access, disclose what the hidden channel was for and end additional disciplinary penalties.
一个想让王座顺着线移动，一个认为线也归王座所有。: One wants the throne to follow the strings. The other thinks the strings belong to the throne too.
两人共享权端，都重视最终决定权；操盘手以谋用饰设计关系、达成即收束，暴君以压惩蔑: Both share Control and care about the final say. The Puppet Master combines Strategy, Instrumental action and Justification, designing relationships and stopping once the goal is reached. The Tyrant combines Pressure, Punitive intent and Disregard, dominating directly and punishing challenges. Conflict often centers on who is using whom.
操盘手认为暴君可制造强确定性，却也是最不肯承认被安排的人。: The Puppet Master thinks the Tyrant can make outcomes highly predictable, but is also the least willing to admit being steered.
暴君欣赏操盘手能让众人就位，但不能容忍幕后者影响自己的最终按钮。: The Tyrant appreciates how the Puppet Master puts everyone in position, but cannot tolerate backstage influence over the final button.
权力交接中，操盘手预先拆解反对阵营，暴君在关键时刻强制完成更替。: During a transfer of power, the Puppet Master dismantles the opposing camp in advance. The Tyrant forces the transition through at the crucial moment.
暴君发现一次决定早被操盘手预设，立即把控制线视作必须惩罚的僭越。: The Tyrant discovers that a decision had already been set up by the Puppet Master and immediately treats the control strings as an overreach that must be punished.
暴君把按钮钥匙推到桌中间，操盘手交出最后一卷控制线；两人共同封进盒里，再各自选一: The Tyrant pushes the button's key to the middle of the table. The Puppet Master hands over the last reel of control string. They seal both in a box together, then each choose their own way out.
控制线意外救了暴君一次，报复幕后者与承认依赖变成同一个选择。: A control string unexpectedly saves the Tyrant. Punishing the backstage planner and acknowledging dependence become two sides of the same decision.
暴君解除惩罚令，操盘手交出全部暗线，并由双方共同决定后续。: The Tyrant withdraws the punishment order. The Puppet Master reveals every hidden connection. They decide what happens next together.
两股声浪从同一舞台冲向人群，谁先停谁就像失去中心。: Two waves of sound reach the crowd from the same stage. Whoever stops first seems to lose the center.
两人同为权谋用蔑，都可能借情绪和阵营取得局面主导，目标成形后即可换场；差异由一人: Both combine Control, Strategy, Instrumental action and Disregard. They may use emotions and opposing camps to lead a situation, then move on once the goal takes shape. One already has an audience; the other has a new story that can spread further.
握听众者把对方当成抢麦新人，也承认那句话确实能穿过人群。: The one with the audience sees a newcomer trying to take the microphone, but admits the new message cuts through the crowd.
握叙事者觉得对方声量大但路径旧，却需要借用那批熟悉的面孔。: The one with the story thinks the other's reach is large but the approach is dated, while still needing those familiar faces.
发起一场公益行动时，一人激活旧社群，一人创造能跨圈传播的鲜明口号。: Launching a community initiative, one activates an established group while the other creates a clear slogan that can travel beyond it.
行动成功后只留一个发言席，两人开始把功劳讲成各自带来的胜利。: After the initiative succeeds, only one spokesperson's seat remains. Both begin telling the story as a victory they personally delivered.
两支扩音器同时没电，两人索性卷起横幅赶末班车；没有听众时，他们仍轮流讲完下一站想: Both megaphones run out of power. They roll up the banner and hurry for the last bus. Without an audience, they still take turns explaining what they want to do at the next stop.
听众要求具体兑现承诺，声量不再足以维持两人的中心位置。: The audience asks for concrete delivery on the promises. Reach and volume can no longer keep either person at the center.
关掉扩音器，各自更正一句夸大内容，并共同列出可兑现行动。: Turn off the megaphones, each correct one exaggerated claim and jointly list actions they can actually deliver.
一个先让全场喊出答案，一个再宣布那就是公正裁决。: One gets the whole room to shout an answer. The other declares it a fair ruling.
两人共享权谋惩，会操纵位置并追罚挑战者；煽动家偏蔑，用情绪夺取主导，权术家偏饰，: Both share Control, Strategy and Punitive intent, manipulating positions and penalizing challengers. The Agitator favors Disregard, using emotion to seize the lead. The Power Broker favors Justification, covering double standards with judging procedures. Public pressure and institutional authority serve each other's purposes.
煽动家觉得权术家借群众壮胆后又把胜利写成自己的判决。: The Agitator thinks the Power Broker borrows courage from the crowd, then presents the victory as a personal ruling.
权术家认为煽动家能制造压力，却会让裁决看起来早有预设。: The Power Broker thinks the Agitator can generate pressure, but makes the verdict look predetermined.
纪律听证前，煽动家聚集舆论要求处理，权术家把诉求转成正式判罚。: Before a disciplinary hearing, the Agitator rallies public demands for action. The Power Broker turns those demands into a formal penalty.
权术家为保住盟友轻判，煽动家转而鼓动人群质疑整个裁席。: The Power Broker gives an ally a light penalty. The Agitator turns the crowd against the entire judging panel.
煽动家把完整录音交到桌上，权术家翻回原始分牌；复核结束后，他们只问彼此要不要一起: The Agitator places the full recording on the table. The Power Broker restores the original scorecards. Once the review is over, they simply ask whether the other would like a late-night meal.
被判者拿出完整录音，群情和程序同时暴露选择性剪裁。: The person judged produces the full recording, exposing selective editing behind both the public outrage and the formal process.
暂停舆论点名和裁决，公开完整材料并交给无关方复核。: Pause the public targeting and the ruling, release the complete material and have an uninvolved party review it.
一个点燃广场上的怒火，一个把余烬收进围绕自己的小圈子。: One ignites anger in the square. The other gathers the embers into a close circle centered on one person.
两人同为权谋惩蔑，都会借叙事与关系掌控阵营，也可能追罚脱离者；差异来自煽动家需要: Both combine Control, Strategy, Punitive intent and Disregard, using stories and relationships to control their groups and possibly punishing those who leave. The Agitator needs momentum that can move on; the Cult Leader values stable belonging and a central belief.
煽动家觉得教主能留住人群，却让每次激情都变成长期服从。: The Agitator thinks the Cult Leader can hold a crowd together, but turns every burst of passion into long-term obedience.
教主认为煽动家擅长点火，但没有中心的热潮随时会换方向。: The Cult Leader thinks the Agitator can start a fire, but a wave of enthusiasm without a center can change direction at any moment.
建立一场新运动时，煽动家迅速聚拢不满者，教主提供长期身份与组织仪式。: When building a movement, the Agitator rapidly gathers dissatisfied people. The Cult Leader provides a lasting identity and organizational rituals.
热潮转向新议题，煽动家想带人离场，教主把迁移视为对中心的背叛。: Public enthusiasm shifts to a new issue. The Agitator wants to take people elsewhere, while the Cult Leader sees the move as a betrayal of the center.
两场集会都散了，他们把不同标语折成纸船放进河里；各自的朋友仍在岸边，两人却自愿沿: Both gatherings have ended. They fold their different slogans into paper boats and set them on the river. Their friends remain on the bank, but the two freely choose to walk a little further together.
最忠诚的追随者拒绝替任何一方攻击旧友，阵营边界第一次被内部打破。: The most loyal follower refuses to attack old friends for either side, breaking the boundary between camps from within for the first time.
停止动员针对个人，开放无惩罚离开，并撤回忠诚测试。: Stop mobilizing people against individuals, allow departure without punishment and withdraw the loyalty tests.
一个让人群相信方向，一个让队伍没有别的方向可走。: One makes the crowd believe in a direction. The other leaves the formation no other way to go.
双方共享权与用，都重视主导局面并可在目标实现后停止；煽动家以谋蔑调动情绪与阵营，: Both share Control and Instrumental action: they value leading the situation and can stop once the goal is achieved. The Agitator combines Strategy and Disregard to mobilize emotions and groups. The Enforcer combines Pressure and Justification to establish unified discipline. Persuasion and command become gateways for each other.
煽动家觉得铁腕者能把口号变成队列，却会压掉自发热情。: The Agitator thinks the Enforcer can turn a slogan into an organized formation, but may suppress spontaneous enthusiasm.
铁腕者认为煽动家能在命令前聚势，也可能让情绪越过纪律边界。: The Enforcer thinks the Agitator can build momentum before an order, but may let emotions spill beyond the limits of discipline.
救援动员中，煽动家快速召集志愿者，铁腕者安排路线、轮班和现场指令。: During rescue mobilization, the Agitator quickly gathers volunteers. The Enforcer assigns routes, shifts and instructions at the scene.
煽动家临时号召队伍改道追热点，铁腕者坚持原救援目标不得更换。: The Agitator suddenly calls for the team to follow a new high-profile incident. The Enforcer insists that the original rescue objective must remain.
救援结束后，煽动家把扩音器调到最低，铁腕者摘下值班哨；他们对着修订路线喝完同一壶: After the rescue, the Agitator turns the megaphone to its lowest setting. The Enforcer takes off the duty whistle. They finish a shared flask of hot water while reviewing the revised route.
真正需要救援的人在相反方向出现，口号与队列都必须及时修正。: People who truly need rescuing appear in the opposite direction. Both the message and the formation must change in time.
停止扩散旧口号，重新确认现场事实，并共同发布修订路线。: Stop spreading the old slogan, check the facts on the ground again and jointly announce a revised route.
一个让万人举旗，一个只在乎旗帜最后写谁的名字。: One gets thousands to raise a flag. The other cares only whose name ends up on it.
双方共享权、用、蔑，可能直接承认对主导局面的追求并在成功后收束；煽动家偏谋，以情: Both share Control, Instrumental action and Disregard, and may openly pursue leadership while stopping once they succeed. The Agitator uses Strategy to guide choices through emotions and opposing camps. The Decider uses Pressure to end negotiation through a personal decision.
煽动家把定局者视作聚焦人群的鲜明中心，也怕对方夺走发声权。: The Agitator sees the Decider as a clear focus for the crowd, but fears losing the right to speak.
定局者认为煽动家能把决定变成声势，但群众热情不能凌驾个人拍板。: The Decider thinks the Agitator can turn a decision into public momentum, but the crowd's enthusiasm must never overrule the personal final say.
危机时期，煽动家聚拢支持和共同口号，定局者快速确定唯一行动方案。: In a crisis, the Agitator brings together support and a shared slogan. The Decider quickly selects a single course of action.
人群开始只听煽动家的解释，定局者撤掉舞台以重申最终决定权。: The crowd begins listening only to the Agitator's explanations. The Decider removes the stage to reassert final decision power.
谢幕时，煽动家把最后一句留给定局者，定局者却关掉聚光灯走回台侧；两人从不同出口出: At the curtain call, the Agitator leaves the last word to the Decider. Instead, the Decider switches off the spotlight and steps to the side. They leave through different exits and meet at the street corner.
人群散去后方案仍需两人亲自执行，声势与命令都失去代理人。: Once the crowd disperses, the two still have to carry out the plan themselves. Public momentum and orders no longer have other people to act through.
撤回效忠要求和群众动员，由双方书面平分一次关键决定权。: Withdraw the demands for loyalty and crowd mobilization, and put an equal division of one key decision into writing.
一个把名字喊遍全城，一个把这个名字从所有纸上抹去。: One shouts a name across the city; the other erases it from every record.
两人共享权与惩，可能处罚挑战者；煽动家以谋蔑借公开情绪取得主导，裁决者以压饰借隐: Both share Control and Punitive tendencies and may punish challengers. The Agitator uses public emotion to gain influence through Strategy and Disregard; the Arbiter uses concealed systems to suppress dissent through Pressure and Justification. Exposure and disappearance become opposite methods of control.
煽动家觉得裁决者把最有传播力的敌人处理得悄无声息，浪费声势。: The Agitator thinks the Arbiter wastes a powerful public enemy by removing them so quietly.
裁决者认为煽动家反复点名只会替异议扩大存在感和证据。: The Arbiter thinks the Agitator's repeated naming only gives dissent more visibility and a stronger record.
面对内部反对时，煽动家先制造孤立氛围，裁决者再冻结对方组织权限。: Facing internal opposition, the Agitator first turns the group against someone; the Arbiter then freezes that person's access and authority.
煽动家需要一个公开对手维持阵营，裁决者坚持让对手及话题彻底退出记录。: The Agitator needs a visible opponent to hold the camp together. The Arbiter wants both the opponent and the subject removed from the record.
裁决者恢复那段被删录音，煽动家没有把它放给人群，只在空房间听完；第二天，他们一起: The Arbiter restores the deleted recording. The Agitator listens alone instead of playing it to a crowd. The next day, they record the missing second half together.
被消失的人留下定时公开材料，两种策略都无法控制下一次传播。: The person they erased has arranged for evidence to be released on a schedule. Neither strategy can control what goes public next.
恢复记录与账号，停止点名动员，并共同撤销对关联者的惩罚。: Restore records and accounts, stop rallying people against named individuals, and jointly reverse penalties imposed on their associates.
一个让万人齐声要求按下按钮，一个提醒按钮只属于一根手指。: One gets thousands to demand that the button be pressed; the other reminds them that only one finger controls it.
双方共享权、惩、蔑，可能追求支配并处罚挑战；煽动家偏谋，通过人群情绪形成压力，暴: Both share Control, Punitive, and Disregard tendencies and may seek dominance and punish challenges. The Agitator uses Strategy to build pressure through collective emotion; the Tyrant uses Pressure to end disputes or impose further costs with a final, unchallengeable decision.
煽动家把暴君当作能兑现口号的终点，却想证明王座也离不开民声。: The Agitator sees the Tyrant as the person who can turn slogans into action, but wants to prove that even the throne depends on public support.
暴君享用煽动家的声势，但无法容忍人群像是在授权而非服从。: The Tyrant enjoys the force of the Agitator's following, but cannot tolerate a crowd that seems to grant authority rather than obey it.
推翻旧秩序时，煽动家聚拢愤怒和阵营，暴君在关键节点执行不可逆更替。: To overthrow an old order, the Agitator gathers anger and builds a camp. At the decisive moment, the Tyrant makes the change irreversible.
胜利后煽动家继续代表人群发号施令，暴君要求所有声音只作自己的回响。: After victory, the Agitator keeps issuing orders in the crowd's name. The Tyrant demands that every voice merely echo their own.
万人散去后，暴君把第二把椅子拖到王座旁，煽动家将扩音器留在台阶下；一句不同意被安: After the crowd leaves, the Tyrant drags a second chair beside the throne. The Agitator leaves the megaphone at the foot of the steps. A quiet disagreement is heard all the way through.
人群忽然为被惩罚者求情，两人第一次被迫面对自己制造的共同意志。: The crowd suddenly pleads for someone being punished. For the first time, both must confront the collective will they helped create.
停止按钮程序与群众围压，公开听取当事人陈述并交出复核权。: Halt the irreversible action and the crowd's pressure, hear the affected person's account publicly, and hand review authority to someone else.
两把尺都很笔直，量到彼此时却各有刻度。: Both measuring sticks look perfectly straight, but each uses a different scale to judge the other.
两人同样重视决定权，偏向通过规则与局面安排推动结果，也可能继续追究挑战。相同语言: Both value decision-making authority, prefer arranging rules and circumstances to shape outcomes, and may keep pursuing a challenge after the immediate issue ends. Their shared language makes each other easier to read; who gets to interpret the rules still depends on their actual positions.
先提出标准的A可能觉得：你理解这把尺，却总想挪动零点。: A, who proposed the standard first, may think: you understand this ruler, but you keep trying to move its zero point.
负责复核的B可能觉得：你说的是共同规则，留下的却是你的例外。: B, who reviews the decision, may think: you call these shared rules, but the exceptions all seem to belong to you.
社区活动出现重复报销时，一人核对原始记录，一人复算标准；两人的主张也接受同样检查: When duplicate reimbursements appear in a community event's accounts, one checks the original records while the other recalculates the amounts. Their own claims face the same scrutiny.
当唯一的最终解释权只能交给一人，争议会从标准内容转向谁有资格判定对方越界。: When only one person can have the final say, the argument shifts from what the standard means to who can declare that the other has crossed a line.
他们都识破对方改过的刻度，却仍把尺交给彼此复核；被看穿后还自愿留在席上，成了少见: Each spots the other's altered markings, yet still hands over the ruler for review. Being seen clearly and choosing to stay at the table becomes a rare kind of reassurance.
一份记录让双方发现各自都改过标准；选择共同更正，或只曝光对方，会把关系推向不同方: A record reveals that both have changed the standard. Correcting it together or exposing only the other's changes will take the relationship in different directions.
把本次标准写在决定之前，列明例外，并让不认同者保有申辩与退出的机会。: Write down the standard before making the decision, list its exceptions, and give those who disagree a chance to appeal or leave.
一人要你承认规则，一人要你承认规则为何属于他。: One asks you to accept the rules; the other asks you to accept why the rules belong to them.
双方同为权、谋、惩，容易围绕忠诚和挑战建立复杂解释。权术家需要可辩护的规范，教主: Both share Control, Strategy, and Punitive tendencies and may build elaborate explanations around loyalty and challenges. The Power Broker needs defensible standards. The Cult Leader relies less on outside approval, but may still build a narrative of their own.
权术家可能欣赏对方凝聚选择的方式，又疑虑个人承诺能否经受公开追问。: The Power Broker may admire the other's ability to unite people behind a choice, while doubting whether personal promises can withstand public questioning.
教主可能把对方的规则解释看成有用的支持，也可能怀疑那是保留异议的出口。: The Cult Leader may see the other's interpretation of the rules as useful support, or suspect that it leaves an escape route for dissent.
临时剧社要分配最后几场演出的名额，一人设计选角条件，一人组织成员认同；两套承诺一: A temporary theatre group must allocate places in its final performances. One designs casting criteria; the other builds the members' commitment. Cooperation needs those two sets of promises to agree.
当成员援引旧规则拒绝新要求，一方可能坚持解释程序，另一方却把拒绝理解为对自己的背: When a member invokes an old rule to refuse a new demand, one may insist on interpreting the procedure while the other treats the refusal as personal betrayal.
权术家递来的纸上只写问题，没有分数；教主也没有索要认同。两人第一次把没想好的话慢: The paper the Power Broker passes over contains questions, with no scores attached. The Cult Leader asks for no pledge of agreement. For once, both take time to finish thoughts they have not yet resolved.
一个曾经被双方认可的人提出离开，如何回应这次离开，会暴露他们真正认可的关系边界。: Someone they both once endorsed decides to leave. Their response reveals the boundaries they actually accept in a relationship.
让承诺有明确范围与结束条件，停止把对具体事项的异议扩大为对整个人的否定。: Give commitments a defined scope and an ending. Stop turning disagreement over a specific matter into rejection of the whole person.
一句决定落地之前，他们先争它究竟该落在哪里。: Before a decision lands, they argue over exactly where it should fall.
两人都重视决定权与规范辩护。权术家偏谋惩，安排裁量并追究挑战；铁腕者偏压用，直接: Both value decision-making authority and defensible standards. The Power Broker uses Strategy and Punitive tendencies to arrange discretion and pursue challenges. The Enforcer uses Pressure and Instrumental tendencies to impose constraints directly, and is more likely to stop once the goal is reached.
权术家可能觉得对方推进得可靠，却在自己还要追究时过早宣布结束。: The Power Broker may find the other's follow-through reliable, yet think they declare the matter closed too soon when further consequences still seem necessary.
铁腕者可能认为对方不断补充理由，令已经恢复的秩序迟迟无法收尾。: The Enforcer may think the other's ever-expanding reasons prevent a restored order from finally settling.
雷雨使活动场地临时关闭，一人说明权限，一人安排离场；天气恢复后按约解除限制，才算: A thunderstorm forces an event venue to close. One explains the authority for the closure; the other organizes the exit. Lifting the restrictions as agreed when conditions improve is part of the same task.
局面已经稳定，一方继续寻找挑战者应付的代价，另一方担心追加要求反而破坏执行。: Once the situation is stable, one keeps looking for a price the challenger should pay. The other worries that further demands will undermine what has already been achieved.
铁腕者交班后把钥匙放下，权术家也合起待议的清单；两人约好这一顿饭不用回答任何考验: After handing over the shift, the Enforcer puts down the keys. The Power Broker closes the list of pending issues. They agree that dinner will contain no tests to pass.
一个曾被视为障碍的人完成补救，是否仍继续追究，会让原来的分工显出价值分歧。: Someone once treated as an obstacle makes amends. Whether to keep pursuing them exposes a difference in values beneath the original division of work.
把要实现的结果与想追加的惩罚分列，重新说明后者的理由，允许另一方明确不参与。: Separate the outcome you need from any extra punishment you want. Explain the latter on its own terms, and allow the other person to decline involvement.
一个说已经决定，一个问谁决定不能再问。: One says the decision is made; the other asks who decided that questions are over.
双方都争决定权，却分别偏向间接裁量与直接压定。权术家重视规范说法、可能追加惩戒；: Both compete for decision-making authority, but one uses indirect discretion and the other direct pressure. The Power Broker values defensible explanations and may add punishment. The Decider relies less on outside approval, using harm mainly to make a decision stick.
权术家可能把对方的定夺看成跳过必要理由，也看成对自己裁量位置的挤压。: The Power Broker may see the other's swift ruling as skipping necessary reasons and crowding out their own discretion.
定局者可能把接连提出的复议理解为拖延，未意识到对方也在争决定权。: The Decider may mistake repeated requests for review for delay, without recognizing that the other person is also seeking a say.
远行队伍需要选路线时，一人查清争议与条件，一人推动行动；约定何时必须重新讨论可以: A travelling group must choose a route. One clarifies disputes and conditions; the other gets people moving. Agreeing when the route must be reconsidered can keep them working together.
新情况出现后，一方要求重审决定，另一方坚持已经说过；事项争论可能变成谁能推翻谁。: When new facts emerge, one demands a review while the other insists that the decision has already been stated. An argument about the issue may become a contest over who can overrule whom.
定局者把扫下桌的方案一张张捡回来；权术家收起预备追究的评语，认真接住那句“再讲给: The Decider picks up the proposals they swept off the table, one by one. The Power Broker puts away the prepared accusations and takes the request seriously: tell me again.
原先最有把握的路线出了问题；是共同承认信息不足，还是借失误争夺位置，决定接下来的: The route they trusted most goes wrong. Whether they admit incomplete information together or use the mistake to fight for position determines what follows.
预先约定触发复议的事实条件，并在复议期间停止把提出问题解释为不服从。: Agree in advance on the facts that should trigger a review. During that review, stop treating questions as disobedience.
一人移动那条线，一人让线外的声音消失。: One moves the boundary; the other silences voices beyond it.

裁决者可能觉得对方的标准总在移动，使自己的行动随时会被重新判定。: The Arbiter may think the other's standards keep moving, leaving any action open to a new judgment at any time.
共同修订一份团体约章时，两人可能很快发现边界问题；合作成立还需要允许成员检验这些: While revising a group's charter together, they may quickly identify boundary issues. Cooperation also requires letting members examine those boundaries.
当一条旧意见被重新归为越界，双方可能互指：是谁放任它出现，又是谁擅自扩大了限制。: When an old opinion is reclassified as out of bounds, they may blame each other: who allowed it in the first place, and who expanded the restrictions without agreement?
权术家在共同稿件旁留出异议的位置，裁决者把对方的原稿完整夹好；那行没有被改掉的话: The Power Broker leaves room for dissent beside their shared draft. The Arbiter carefully keeps the other's original intact. The sentence that was allowed to remain is read twice.
一次被删去的记录被找回，两人需要面对共同造成的后果；承担或推责会把联盟导向相反结: A deleted record is recovered. Both must face the consequences they helped create; taking responsibility or shifting blame leads the alliance toward opposite endings.
恢复完整记录，把具体后果与异议本身区分，暂停对表达者追加要求。: Restore the full record, distinguish specific consequences from dissent itself, and pause further demands on the person who spoke.
批示只有一行，围绕它的解释却写不完。: The ruling is one line long; the explanations around it never end.
两人都看重决定权，也可能在挑战后继续要求代价。权术家以谋与饰保留裁量，暴君以压与: Both value decision-making authority and may demand further costs after a challenge. The Power Broker preserves discretion through Strategy and Justification; the Tyrant rules directly through Pressure and Disregard. They compete over who gets to interpret the final word.
权术家可能认为没有可辩护的理由，决定就会留下难以收拾的后果。: The Power Broker may believe that a decision without defensible reasons will leave consequences that are hard to contain.
暴君可能把对方补充理由的举动理解为支持，也可能视为变相改写自己的决定。: The Tyrant may read the other's added reasons as support, or as an indirect attempt to rewrite the decision.
虚构城邦面临一次紧急裁决时，两人可能分别提供理由与行动压力；合作持续需要实际权限: In a fictional city-state facing an urgent ruling, one may supply the rationale and the other the pressure to act. Lasting cooperation needs clear boundaries on their actual authority.
一句批示被解释出例外，暴君认为决定遭到稀释，权术家则认为自己的解释权正在被取消。: An exception is read into a ruling. The Tyrant believes the decision is being diluted; the Power Broker believes their interpretive authority is being removed.
权术家把异议写在批示背面，暴君读完暂缓决定；第二天，空白批示被推回桌中间，等两人: The Power Broker writes an objection on the back of the ruling. The Tyrant reads it and postpones the decision. The next day, a blank order returns to the middle of the table, waiting for both to write.
暴君的一项要求第一次落到权术家自己身上；此前用过的理由是否还算数，会让关系重新显: For the first time, one of the Tyrant's demands applies to the Power Broker personally. Whether the old reasons still count reveals their relationship anew.
让受影响的人能回应具体事项，并设置决定可被撤回的入口，停止以异议本身追加惩罚。: Let affected people respond to the specific issue and provide a way to withdraw the decision. Stop adding punishment simply because someone disagrees.
两轮太阳都在发光，也都看见了对方的轨道。: Both suns are shining, and each can see the other's orbit.
两人同样倾向围绕自己组织认同，重视控制与背离的代价，较少依赖外部规范认可。谁先被: Both tend to organize loyalty around themselves, value control and the costs of defection, and rely less on outside standards for approval. Who approaches first and who has other relationships available still create different positions.
先邀请B加入的A可能欣赏其吸引力，却把对方独立的圈子读成没有真正靠近。: A, who first invited B to join, may admire B's appeal while reading B's independent circle as a failure to truly draw close.
接受合作的B可能觉得自己被认真理解，也担心邀请的尽头只是加入A的轨道。: B may feel deeply understood by the invitation to work together, yet worry that it ultimately means entering A's orbit.
两人共同发起一个自愿参与的计划时，可以各自组织认同；明确允许参与者离开，合作才有: When launching a voluntary project together, each can build support in their own way. Explicitly allowing participants to leave gives the cooperation a shared foundation.
同一位伙伴同时支持双方，可能被一人当成连接，被另一人当成不够专一，竞争由此扩大。: A companion supports both of them. One may see that as a bridge; the other may see divided loyalty, widening the competition.
各自散场后，两人在没有追随者的旧车站碰面；谁都保留原来的世界，却仍愿意为这次约会: After their separate gatherings end, they meet at an old station with no followers around. Each keeps a world of their own, yet still makes time for this date.
有一天B不再参加A的一次活动；这个缺席被理解为普通选择还是背离，会改写关系方向。: One day, B skips one of A's events. Whether that absence counts as an ordinary choice or a betrayal changes the relationship's direction.
把一次拒绝限制在那件事上，停止忠诚考验，并让双方保有独立联系与退出空间。: Keep a refusal specific to the matter refused. End loyalty tests, and let both people maintain independent connections and room to leave.
门可以同时打开，进门需要的理由却各不相同。: Both doors can open at once, but each requires a different reason to enter.
两人都重决定权。教主倾向通过认同组织选择、追究背离，铁腕者偏向直接约束、以秩序解: Both value decision-making authority. The Cult Leader tends to organize choices through identification and pursue perceived betrayal. The Enforcer favors direct constraints, explains them through order, and stops when the goal is reached. Acceptance and control may come with different conditions.
教主可能认为对方只看是否完成要求，没有理解自己在意的认同和归属。: The Cult Leader may think the other only checks whether a demand was met, missing the identification and belonging that matter to them.
铁腕者可能觉得对方不断增加态度要求，让明确条件变成没有尽头的考验。: The Enforcer may feel that the other's extra demands about attitude turn clear conditions into an endless test.
安排一次共同驻留活动时，一人组织参与意愿，一人说明行动边界；两套条件一致时可以顺: For a shared residency program, one builds willingness to take part while the other explains practical boundaries. The handover can work smoothly if both sets of conditions agree.
一位参与者完成所有约定却选择离开，双方可能争论：事情已经结束，还是仍欠一份忠诚。: A participant fulfills every agreement and then chooses to leave. They may argue over whether the matter is finished or a debt of loyalty remains.
教主按约结束邀请，铁腕者把备用钥匙放回公用桌面；两人关门离场，约定下次见面由彼此: The Cult Leader ends the invitation as agreed. The Enforcer returns the spare key to the shared table. They lock up and leave, agreeing to choose their next meeting time together.
铁腕者按约解除限制，教主却希望保留人员；提前说清或事后加码，会产生不同的结局。: The Enforcer lifts restrictions as promised, but the Cult Leader wants people to stay. Stating that wish in advance or adding it afterward leads to different endings.
列出有限且可完成的要求，达成后兑现结束承诺，不追罚按约退出的人。: Set finite, achievable requirements and honor the promised ending when they are met. Do not punish anyone for leaving on the agreed terms.
都想站在光里，却未必想让人看见同一件事。: Both want to stand in the light, but they may want it to reveal different things.
双方重决定权、较少依赖规范认可。教主偏向组织认同并追究背离，定局者偏向直接落实意: Both value decision-making authority and rely less on approval from external standards. The Cult Leader tends to build identification and pursue betrayal; the Decider tends to impose their will directly. One may keep asking about attitudes while the other thinks action is enough.
教主可能看重对方的推进能力，却不确定没有表态的执行算不算认可自己。: The Cult Leader may value the other's ability to get things moving, yet wonder whether carrying out a plan without declaring support counts as personal recognition.
定局者可能认为事情既然做成，继续要求表明立场是在重复索取决定权。: The Decider may think that once the task is done, further demands for a declared position are another claim on decision-making authority.
共同筹办一场演出时，一人凝聚参与，一人推动关键取舍；承认各自负责的范围能让计划继: While putting on a performance together, one builds participation and the other drives the key decisions. Recognizing each person's area of responsibility lets the plan move forward.
谢幕时谁站中间成为争点，原先关于作品的合作可能被改写成谁拥有整个舞台。: Who stands at center stage for the curtain call becomes a dispute. Cooperation on the work may turn into a contest over who owns the whole stage.
谢幕后，教主把聚光灯推向定局者，定局者却问他要不要一起离场；这一次，两人把答案留: After the curtain call, the Cult Leader turns the spotlight toward the Decider. The Decider asks whether they would like to leave together. This time, each leaves the answer to the other.
聚光灯意外照向第三个人，两人是承认其贡献还是把关注争回来，会暴露共同目标的分量。: The spotlight unexpectedly falls on a third person. Whether they acknowledge that contribution or try to reclaim the attention reveals how much their shared goal matters.
先确认具体贡献和约定，再讨论位置，停止要求所有人用站队表达感谢。: Recognize specific contributions and agreements before discussing position. Stop demanding that everyone express gratitude by choosing a side.
一句话被重复很多次，直到他们开始寻找另一个声音。: A sentence is repeated so often that they begin to search for another voice.
双方同重控制与惩戒。教主侧重组织认同、较少依赖外部规范，裁决者侧重直接划界并借秩: Both value control and punishment. The Cult Leader focuses on building identification and relies less on external standards; the Arbiter draws boundaries directly and defends them in the name of order. A shared account can create understanding or conceal disagreement.
教主可能把对方维持口径看成忠诚，却难以确定那是否来自真实认同。: The Cult Leader may take the other's adherence to the shared account as loyalty, while remaining unsure whether it reflects real agreement.
裁决者可能觉得对方总能改变解释，使已经划出的边界忽然失去依据。: The Arbiter may feel that the other can always change the explanation, suddenly leaving established boundaries without a basis.
共同整理一场争论的记录时，两人可能迅速形成版本；若允许原始意见保留，才有可检验的: While assembling a record of a dispute, they may quickly agree on a version. Their cooperation becomes open to scrutiny only if the original views can remain.
一条异议与教主的最新说法相符，却违反裁决者先前的边界，两人可能互相指责破坏共同口: An objection agrees with the Cult Leader's latest account but crosses a boundary the Arbiter set earlier. Each may accuse the other of breaking their shared position.
裁决者记住教主没让众人听见的那句犹豫；教主第二天只对他讲完后半句，秘密没有被拿去: The Arbiter remembers the hesitation the Cult Leader kept from the crowd. The next day, the Cult Leader finishes that thought for the Arbiter alone. The secret is not traded for loyalty.
一直附和的伙伴突然沉默，他们需要决定是继续索要表态，还是承认此前没有给出真实选择: A companion who always agreed suddenly falls silent. They must decide whether to demand another declaration or admit that they never offered a real choice.
保留不同版本和说话者的原意，取消因表达分歧而追加的代价，让回应可以暂缓。: Keep different versions and each speaker's intended meaning. Remove added costs for expressing disagreement, and allow people to take time before responding.
两种力量都想把轨道拉向自己，靠近便需要新的距离。: Both forces pull the orbit toward themselves; getting closer requires a new sense of distance.
双方同为权、惩、蔑，都可能要求控制并追究背离。教主更常通过认同和选择安排起作用，: Both share Control, Punitive, and Disregard tendencies and may demand control and pursue betrayal. The Cult Leader more often works through identification and arranged choices; the Tyrant more often imposes a decision directly. Their actual influence on each other depends on who relies on whom.
教主可能觉得对方能让局面立即改变，却会压缩自己组织认同的空间。: The Cult Leader may think the other can change a situation immediately, but leaves less room to build personal allegiance.
暴君可能疑惑：对方似乎没有直接命令，为什么自己的决定仍会被牵动？: The Tyrant may wonder: if the other person gives no direct orders, why do my decisions still bend around them?
共同搭建的展台临近闭馆，教主组织愿意留下的人，暴君推动撤场取舍；临时授权到场地归: Closing time approaches at their shared exhibition stand. The Cult Leader gathers willing helpers; the Tyrant drives decisions about packing up. Temporary authority ends when the space is returned.
危机解除后谁保留临时权力成为争点，一次不同意可能被双方都扩大成必须回敬的挑战。: Once the crisis is over, retaining temporary powers becomes the dispute. Either may turn a single disagreement into a challenge that demands retaliation.
两人各写了一条出游路线，都给对方留了改选的空白；他们第一次期待答案，而不是提前安: Each writes a travel route and leaves space for the other to choose differently. For the first time, they look forward to an answer instead of arranging it in advance.
共同目标消失以后，他们仍愿意维持怎样的联系，会决定旧联盟是解散、争位还是重新靠近: When the shared goal disappears, the connection they still want determines whether the old alliance dissolves, becomes a struggle for position, or makes room for new closeness.
为临时授权设定结束时点，兑现退出承诺，停止把对方的独立选择当作需要惩戒的事件。: Set an end time for temporary authority, honor promises that people can leave, and stop treating the other's independent choices as offenses to punish.
两把钥匙都能关门，故事从谁愿意开门开始。: Both keys can lock the door. The story begins with who is willing to open it.
两人同为权压用饰，偏向直接约束并以秩序辩护，达到控制目标后较可能停止。共同标准可: Both share Control, Pressure, Instrumental, and Justification tendencies. They favor direct constraints defended in the name of order and are more likely to stop once control is secured. Shared standards can reduce the need for explanation, but shifts, authority, and responsibility may still be unequal.
当班的A可能觉得B熟悉所有要求，却偏偏在执行时提出自己的版本。: A, who is on duty, may think B knows every requirement yet insists on introducing a different version during implementation.
准备接班的B可能担心A留下未说明的限制，自己却要承担接下来的责任。: B, who is preparing to take over, may worry that A will leave unexplained restrictions while B inherits the responsibility.
共同维持一次夜间行动的秩序时，清楚的交接可以让两人各自负责一段，不必互相重复发令: While keeping a nighttime operation orderly, a clear handover lets each take responsibility for one stretch without issuing duplicate commands.
两人对何时解除约束意见不同，命令若同时发出，原本稳定的配合便会变成对权限的争夺。: They disagree about when to lift restrictions. If both issue orders at once, stable coordination can become a contest over authority.
夜班交接后，一人第一次说自己撑不住；另一人接过钥匙，只守约定的那一段，给对方留下: After the night shift handover, one admits for the first time that they cannot keep going. The other takes the keys, covers only the agreed stretch, and leaves a cup of warm water.
A必须提前离开，是否完整交出信息与权限，会让B把交接读成信任或甩下责任。: A must leave early. Whether they fully hand over information and authority determines whether B reads it as trust or dumped responsibility.
明确谁负责哪一段，说明约束何时解除，并让受影响者能够提出不同情况。: Clarify who handles each stage and when restrictions end. Give affected people a way to raise circumstances the plan did not account for.
同一项决定，一人找它的依据，一人留下自己的印记。: For the same decision, one looks for its basis; the other leaves a personal stamp.
双方同为权、压、用，可能理解直接推进和有限目标。铁腕者需要秩序与程序的说法，定局: Both share Control, Pressure, and Instrumental tendencies and may understand direct action toward a limited goal. The Enforcer needs an account grounded in order and procedure; the Decider relies less on approval from standards. Whose decision counts and why it counts may be different questions.
铁腕者可能认为对方推进迅速，却不断留下无法向其他人说明的例外。: The Enforcer may think the other moves quickly but keeps leaving exceptions that cannot be explained to everyone else.
定局者可能觉得对方已经赞同结果，仍要求补充依据是在延迟执行。: The Decider may feel that once the other agrees with the outcome, asking for more justification only delays action.
共同应对设备故障时，两人都能围绕有限目标行动；事先说明权限与恢复条件可减少相互掣: During an equipment failure, both can act toward a limited goal. Clarifying authority and the conditions for restoring normal operations beforehand reduces interference between them.
事情办成后一项例外被追问，一方要求补足记录，另一方认为自己的决定本身就足以结束讨: After the job is done, an exception is questioned. One asks for a complete record; the other considers the decision itself enough to end the discussion.
定局者的决定页旁多了一张空白便签，铁腕者写下不同想法；两人把日期往后挪一点，留出: A blank note appears beside the Decider's decision. The Enforcer writes a different view on it. They move the date back a little, making time to talk it through properly.
定局者的临时决定碰到铁腕者认可的边界，是否接受共同核对，会决定合作能否延续。: The Decider's temporary decision crosses a boundary the Enforcer accepts. Willingness to review it together determines whether cooperation can continue.
把临时措施的范围与期限说清，停止扩张已完成的授权，并共同回应受到影响的人。: State the scope and duration of temporary measures. Stop expanding authority whose purpose is already fulfilled, and respond together to those affected.
事情已经封存，封条后面却还留着一笔未结的账。: The matter is sealed, but an unsettled account remains behind the seal.
双方同为权、压、饰。铁腕者偏用，控制目标完成后较可能结束；裁决者偏惩，可能仍要异: Both share Control, Pressure, and Justification tendencies. The Enforcer's Instrumental tendency makes them more likely to stop when control is secured. The Arbiter's Punitive tendency may still demand a cost from dissenters. The same language of order conceals different endings.
铁腕者可能觉得对方不断翻出旧事，使已经恢复的安排无法真正稳定。: The Enforcer may think the other keeps reviving old issues, preventing restored arrangements from ever becoming stable.
裁决者可能把对方及时结束理解为放过挑战，没有给秩序留下足够明确的回应。: The Arbiter may read a timely ending as letting a challenge go unanswered and failing to defend order clearly enough.
共同收拾一次失控的排练时，两人可以先恢复行动边界；是否按约结束追究决定合作能走多: After a rehearsal gets out of control, both can first restore practical boundaries. Whether they stop pursuing the matter as agreed determines how far their cooperation goes.
排练已能继续，一方却仍要求追查曾经反对的人，另一方开始认为追加行动本身妨碍目标。: The rehearsal can resume, yet one still wants to investigate those who objected. The other begins to see the extra action itself as an obstacle to the goal.
一次已经完成的补救被郑重划去，两人没有翻到新的追究页；空出的晚上，改为各选一首歌: A completed act of repair is formally crossed off the list. Neither turns to a new page of accusations. With the evening freed up, each picks a song for the other instead.
同一个人完成补救却仍被排除，两人需要直面：恢复秩序与继续追究已经成了两件事。: Someone makes amends but remains excluded. Both must face the fact that restoring order and continuing to pursue them have become separate matters.
说明哪些后果已经处理、哪些责任尚未回应，为追究设限，停止无限增加新的条件。: Explain which consequences have been addressed and which responsibilities remain unresolved. Set limits on the response and stop adding conditions without end.
都能让水停下来，却未必同意什么时候开闸。: Both can stop the water, but they may not agree on when to open the gates.
两人同样偏向直接争取决定权。铁腕者以秩序说明有限控制，暴君较少依赖规范认可，且可: Both favor directly asserting decision-making authority. The Enforcer explains limited control through order. The Tyrant relies less on approval from standards and may keep punishing after control is secured. They differ on both the reasons for restrictions and when those restrictions should end.
铁腕者可能认为对方的追加要求已经越过原先目标，让约束失去可说明的终点。: The Enforcer may think the other's extra demands exceed the original goal, leaving the restrictions with no defensible ending.

一次限时守门任务能使两人暂时同向；谁有权开门、何时结束，需要在压力出现前讲清楚。: A gatekeeping task with a fixed duration can temporarily align them. Who can open the gate and when the task ends must be clear before pressure arrives.
约定时间已到，一方准备解除限制，另一方坚持让曾挑战自己的人继续等待，门口成为权力: The agreed time has passed. One prepares to lift restrictions; the other insists that someone who challenged them must keep waiting. The gate becomes a contest over power.
铁腕者说今天想独处，暴君把预定见面的时间划掉；傍晚收到一句自愿的问候，比强留的人: The Enforcer says they want to be alone today. The Tyrant crosses out the planned meeting. A freely offered greeting that evening matters more than a person forced to stay.
被限制的人带来新的证据，双方是否允许证据改变决定，会让共同立场松动或重新建立。: Someone under restriction brings new evidence. Whether both allow it to change the decision can loosen or rebuild their common position.
先兑现已经约定的解除条件，分开讨论新的事项，避免把暂停追究理解为必须认输。: First honor the conditions already agreed for lifting restrictions, then discuss new issues separately. Pausing further action need not mean admitting defeat.
两句“听我的”撞在一起，第三条路才开始出现。: Two demands to follow my lead collide, and a third route begins to appear.
两人同为权压用蔑，偏向直接施压、较少依赖规范认可，达到控制目标后较可能停止。谁在: Both share Control, Pressure, Instrumental, and Disregard tendencies. They favor direct pressure, rely less on approval from standards, and are more likely to stop once control is secured. Experience and resources still determine who has the advantage in this task.
提出方案的A可能觉得B只要再配合一步就能成功，却没意识到自己也拒绝让出决定。: A, who proposes the plan, may think success only needs one more step of cooperation from B, without noticing their own refusal to share the decision.
负责实际操作的B可能认为A没有承担同样后果，却不断替自己作主。: B, who carries out the work, may think A keeps deciding for them without bearing the same consequences.
共同穿越一段陌生路线时，双方若按已知信息分段决定，可以把各自的行动意愿接起来。: On an unfamiliar route together, dividing decisions by the information each person has can connect their separate willingness to act.
路口只能选一条方向，争论可能从证据变成谁先让步，哪怕双方都已看见第三个可行方案。: At a junction, only one direction can be chosen. The argument may shift from evidence to who gives way first, even when both can see a third workable option.
岔路口，一人把地图推给对方决定，也说出自己的担心；下一段路，两人自愿换位，记住了: At a fork in the road, one passes over the map and the choice while also sharing a worry. On the next stretch they willingly swap roles, learning each other's pace.
A掌握的信息被证实过时；是否承认B的新判断，会使交锋转为合作或继续扩大。: A's information proves outdated. Accepting B's new judgment can turn confrontation into cooperation; refusing it can deepen the conflict.
先说各自掌握的事实与承担的后果，为这一次决定划定范围，不延伸成永久的高低位置。: Start with the facts each person has and the consequences each will bear. Limit the scope of this decision instead of turning it into a permanent hierarchy.
一个已经签下决定，另一个在边上补了一条不能。: One has already signed the decision; the other adds a prohibition in the margin.
双方同重决定权并直接施压。定局者较少需要规范认可、目标达成后可结束，裁决者倾向以: Both value decision-making authority and apply direct pressure. The Decider relies less on approval from standards and may stop once the goal is reached. The Arbiter tends to justify punishment through order. Who can veto whose decision can become the relationship's central question.
定局者可能认为对方总在决定之后追加边界，让已经完成的行动重新变成未获许可。: The Decider may think the other always adds boundaries after a decision, turning a completed action back into something unauthorized.
裁决者可能觉得对方随时为自己开例外，使此前对异议的处理失去一致依据。: The Arbiter may think the other can grant themselves an exception at any time, undermining the consistency of earlier responses to dissent.
共同管理一场限时比赛时，两人可以分别推动进度与说明边界，前提是规则也约束他们自己: While managing a timed competition together, one can drive progress and the other clarify boundaries, provided the rules constrain their own decisions too.
定局者临时更改安排，裁决者将其视为破坏秩序；原先对外的压力转为双方互相否决。: The Decider changes the arrangements on short notice. The Arbiter treats it as a breach of order. Pressure once directed outward becomes a cycle of mutual vetoes.
定局者把尚未盖章的草稿递过去，裁决者留下两句不同意见；第二版仍有分歧，却第一次同: The Decider passes over an unstamped draft. The Arbiter adds two objections. The second version still contains disagreement, but carries both names for the first time.
一次例外同时帮助了两人，他们是否愿意承认并回应此前受影响者，会改变相互信任。: An exception benefits both of them. Whether they admit it and respond to those affected earlier changes their mutual trust.
暂停继续追加限制，公开本次变更影响的范围，让反对意见保留在记录中并得到具体回应。: Pause further restrictions, make the effects of this change clear, and keep objections on the record with specific responses.
同一场交锋，一人写到胜负，另一人还想写后半章。: One writes the confrontation through to victory or defeat; the other still wants another chapter.
双方同为权、压、蔑，都偏好直接争取决定权。定局者偏用，达到控制目标后较可能停止；: Both share Control, Pressure, and Disregard tendencies and prefer directly asserting decision-making authority. The Decider's Instrumental tendency makes them more likely to stop once control is secured. The Tyrant's Punitive tendency may add costs even after obedience is won.
定局者可能觉得结果已定，对方却让每次结束都多出一项没有预告的要求。: The Decider may think the result is settled, yet the other adds an unannounced requirement to every ending.
暴君可能把对方准备收手理解为低估挑战，甚至认为其在阻止自己的最后决定。: The Tyrant may read the other's readiness to stop as underestimating the challenge, or even as blocking the final decision.
两人都想让同一支临时队伍按时出发，可以先围绕清楚的行程分工；到站后谁还要追究迟到: Both want the same temporary team to leave on time and can first divide the work around a clear itinerary. Whether anyone still pursues the latecomers after arrival tests the original agreement.
障碍已经排除，一方仍要让反对者额外受损，另一方开始阻止，原来的并肩由此转成对峙。: The obstacle is gone, but one still wants opponents to suffer an extra loss. The other steps in to stop it, turning former allies into adversaries.
约好的争论时间到了，两人把纸翻到空白一面，各画一道想吃的菜；这次没有下一关，也没: The agreed time for arguing is up. They turn the paper over and each draws a dish they would like to eat. This time there is no next test, and nobody has to concede defeat.
曾经被要求让步的人已经履行承诺；是否还追加条件，会让双方看见彼此不同的停止规则。: Someone who was asked to compromise has fulfilled the promise. Whether further conditions follow reveals their different rules for stopping.
确认已经实现的目标，撤下临时加码，把仍未解决的事项另行说清，允许双方保持距离。: Confirm the goal already achieved, withdraw last-minute additions, and state unresolved matters separately. Allow both people to keep some distance.
两个人都能让场面安静，安静里却藏着尚未说完的话。: Both can quiet a room. In that quiet, something remains unsaid.
双方同样重视控制与惩戒，偏向直接划界并用秩序解释。相同口径可能让行动一致，也可能: Both value control and punishment, favor direct boundaries, and explain them through order. A shared account may align their actions or make each afraid to voice reservations. What their silence means needs separate consideration.
负责提出边界的A可能把B的安静当作赞同，没有发现对方还在等待说明。: A, who sets the boundary, may mistake B's silence for agreement, missing that B is still waiting for an explanation.
承担落实的B可能担心一旦提出不同情况，自己也会被放到需要解释的位置上。: B, who implements it, may fear that raising a different circumstance will put them in the position of having to defend themselves.
共同修整一份有争议的记录时，两人能快速找到表述差异；保留原始内容才让合作具有可复: While revising a disputed record, both can quickly find differences in wording. Keeping the original content makes their cooperation open to review.
一段被省略的话后来引发问题，双方都可能追问是谁遗漏、谁默许，使共同沉默变成相互指: An omitted passage later causes trouble. Each may ask who left it out and who allowed it, turning their shared silence into mutual accusation.
两份相同的记录旁忽然多出一行不同意。另一人读完没有删掉，只在旁边写了“明天继续听: Beside two identical records, a line of disagreement suddenly appears. The other reads it and leaves it intact, adding only: I will hear the rest tomorrow.
B第一次主动留下异议，A把它视为补充还是挑战，会让关系获得新空间或继续收紧。: B records an objection unprompted for the first time. Whether A treats it as added information or a challenge gives the relationship new room or tightens it further.
停止把没有表态视为同意，恢复异议记录，并说明表达不同意见不会带来额外惩戒。: Stop treating the absence of a statement as consent. Restore records of dissent and make clear that expressing a different view will not bring extra punishment.
都能让决定落下，只有一人还在寻找能公开念出的理由。: Both can bring a decision down. Only one is still looking for a reason that can be read aloud in public.
双方同为权、压、惩，可能共同要求服从与追加代价。裁决者需要秩序的辩护，暴君较少依: Both share Control, Pressure, and Punitive tendencies and may demand obedience and further costs together. The Arbiter needs a defense grounded in order; the Tyrant relies less on approval from standards. Similar actions can still require different public explanations.
裁决者可能觉得对方一句随意的表态，就能使自己准备的全部理由失去可信度。: The Arbiter may think a single casual remark from the other can discredit every reason they prepared.
暴君可能觉得对方既然愿意落实决定，就不该再用程序和解释限制自己的意志。: The Tyrant may think that if the other is willing to carry out the decision, they should not use procedure and explanation to limit that will.
在虚构审议场景里，两人可能迅速形成强硬立场；只有允许证据与申辩改变决定，合作才有: In a fictional hearing, they may quickly adopt a hard line together. Their cooperation leaves room for correction only if evidence and a defense can change the decision.
暴君公开否定原来的理由，裁决者却仍要解释同一项行动，双方可能争夺谁承担后果。: The Tyrant publicly rejects the original reasons while the Arbiter must still explain the same action. They may fight over who bears the consequences.
裁决者把尚有疑问的纸摊开，暴君让决定停了一晚；第二天他们从第一句重新读起，谁都可: The Arbiter spreads out the papers that still raise questions. The Tyrant lets the decision wait overnight. The next day they read again from the first sentence, with either free to propose changes.
新证据让共同立场站不住脚，选择一同承担并撤回决定，或把责任推给对方，会形成不同关: New evidence makes their shared position untenable. Taking responsibility and withdrawing the decision together, or blaming each other, produces different relationships.
先暂停不可挽回的行动，允许受影响者回应，承认撤回错误决定不等于否定整个人。: First pause irreversible action and let those affected respond. Recognize that withdrawing a mistaken decision does not mean rejecting the whole person.
两顶冠冕都不愿低下，桌边却可以多留一把椅子。: Neither crown wants to bow, but there can still be another chair at the table.
两人同样重视决定权，偏向直接施压并在挑战后继续追究，较少依赖规范认可。相同倾向不: Both value decision-making authority, favor direct pressure, may keep pursuing a challenge afterward, and rely less on approval from standards. Shared tendencies do not erase differences in power, dependence, or history, and need not fix one person in submission.
先占据位置的A可能把B的独立决定看作挑战，却忽略对方也有自己的任务与承诺。: A, who occupies the position first, may see B's independent decision as a challenge, overlooking B's own responsibilities and promises.
带来关键资源的B可能认为自己有权参与决定，A的让步却总附带新的条件。: B, who brings essential resources, may believe they deserve a say, yet every concession from A comes with new conditions.
虚构城邦的两座水闸必须同时开启，一人握钥匙，一人掌握时刻表；承认彼此有限权限，才: Two floodgates in a fictional city-state must open at once. One holds the key; the other has the schedule. Completing the task together requires recognizing each person's limited authority.
危机过去，谁留下最终决定权成为争点；任何一次回敬都可能被另一方记作必须追加代价的: Once the crisis is over, who retains the final say becomes the dispute. Either may record each retaliation as a fresh challenge that demands another cost.
两把椅子被自愿移到窗边，冠冕放在桌上；这次约好只看日落，谁也不用替谁决定什么时候: They willingly move two chairs to the window and put the crowns on the table. This time they agree only to watch the sunset. Neither has to decide when the other leaves.
A第一次需要B的许可，是否承认此前要求别人遵守的边界，会让两人重新理解平等参与。: For the first time, A needs B's permission. Whether A accepts boundaries previously demanded of others changes how both understand equal participation.
先停止互相加码，明确各自可决定和不可越过的范围，并让退出共同任务不再触发报复。: First stop escalating against each other. Clarify what each may decide and which boundaries neither may cross. Leaving the shared task must no longer trigger retaliation.
基于公开假设，真实比例未知。: Based on stated assumptions. The actual share is unknown.

# 类型在人群中的占比，是怎样估算的？\n\n这里说明「人群占比（模型估算）」的: # How Are the Estimated Population Shares of the Types Calculated? This page explains the method and current basis for the “Population Share (Model Estimate).” We publish the assumptions, calculations, and version so you can see where the figures come from. **The actual shares of the 16 Shades types in the population are currently unknown. The percentages on this page come from a publicly specified hypothetical scenario and have not been calibrated against real population data.** The figures shown here demonstrate the method. Any figures used on later results pages should correspond to the scenario version cited there. ## What Does This Figure Mean? It means that if the four tendencies are distributed in the proportions we specify, and if the stated assumptions about how they combine hold, each type would account for a certain share within this model. For example, if a type has a model share of about 13%, it accounts for about 13% of this hypothetical distribution. That cannot be translated into “13 out of every 100 people in the real world share your type.” A model can turn assumptions into numbers; calculation alone cannot show that those assumptions resemble reality. These types describe people's strategic tendencies in relevant situations. Names such as “Tyrant” and “Broker” are personified labels. A name alone cannot tell us that a type is rarer, and population share cannot tell us how bad or admirable someone is, or whether they will harm others. ## Why Start with Four Axes? The sixteen types are combinations of four tendencies, always in this order: | Axis | Two poles | Question examined | |---|---|---| | Goal | Gain / Control | When tangible gain and decision-making power cannot both be secured, which would the person rather retain? | | Path of influence | Strategy / Pressure | Does the person rely more on arranging information, options, and relationships, or on explicitly setting conditions and consequences? | | Conflict closure | Instrumental / Punitive | After the external objective or remedy has been achieved, does the person still want the other party to pay an additional price? | | Justification | Justification / Disregard | Does the person rely more on shared rules and reasons, or more readily authorize a choice through their own priorities? | Choosing one pole on each axis produces sixteen combinations. Broker, for example, corresponds to Gain–Strategy–Instrumental–Justification, while Tyrant corresponds to Control–Pressure–Punitive–Disregard. Publishing the distribution assumptions for the four axes first and applying one calculation rule keeps the figures for all sixteen types internally consistent and easy to check. These sixteen combinations are the classification defined by this project. There is currently no evidence that people naturally cluster into these sixteen categories. Nor does the existence of sixteen types imply that each must account for 6.25%. ## What Assumptions Does the Current Demonstration Use? Demonstration Scenario A, version `type-share-scenario-0.1`, recorded on 2026-09-07. ### Input Proportions for the Four Axes | Axis | Demonstration input | Scenario examined by this input | Basis for the figures | |---|---|---|---| | Gain / Control | 60% / 40% | Somewhat more model subjects favor tangible gain | Manually chosen demonstration parameters; not empirically measured | | Strategy / Pressure | 55% / 45% | The two paths of influence are close to balanced, with indirect arrangement slightly more common | Manually chosen demonstration parameters; not empirically measured | | Instrumental / Punitive | 65% / 35% | Somewhat more model subjects tend to stop once the external objective has been achieved | Manually chosen demonstration parameters; not empirically measured | | Justification / Disregard | 60% / 40% | Somewhat more model subjects rely on shared grounds to authorize their choices | Manually chosen demonstration parameters; not empirically measured | **These figures make one imagined scenario concrete. We currently have no data showing that 60% is closer to reality than 55%, and no evidence that the relative ordering in the table matches any real population.** They are not statistical findings drawn from psychology papers, a distribution of website users' assessment results, or a sample produced by AI-simulated respondents. ### How the Four Axes Are Combined For this demonstration, the four axes are provisionally treated as independent. In other words, which pole a model subject favors on one axis does not change the proportions of their tendencies on the other axes. This assumption was chosen to simplify the calculation. The fact that the four questions can be distinguished conceptually does not prove that they are unrelated in reality. The same four input proportions can produce a different distribution across the sixteen types if different relationships among the axes are assumed. ### Who Is Included in the 100% Denominator? The denominator in this demonstration is an idealized set in which every model subject has a definite direction on all four axes and belongs to exactly one type. The sixteen types in the table total 100% only within this set. Real assessments may produce ties, near-boundary results, insufficient information, or multiple candidates. This demonstration does not estimate how common those cases are in the population, or what share of the total population can be assigned an unambiguous type. The figures in the table therefore cannot directly represent the entire population. This distribution has not been calibrated for any country, age group, occupation, or other real-world population. A classification of everyday tendencies also cannot be converted into the incidence of harmful behavior. ## How Is It Calculated? Under the independence assumption, a type's share equals the product of the proportions for its corresponding poles on the four axes. For example, Broker corresponds to Gain–Strategy–Instrumental–Justification: ```text Broker model share = Gain proportion × Strategy proportion × Instrumental proportion × Justification proportion = 0.60 × 0.55 × 0.65 × 0.60 = 0.1287 = 12.87% ``` Tyrant corresponds to Control–Pressure–Punitive–Disregard: ```text Tyrant model share = 0.40 × 0.45 × 0.35 × 0.40 = 0.0252 = 2.52% ``` Every other type uses exactly the same rule. Because the two poles of each axis sum to 1, the sum of all combinations is: ```text (0.60 + 0.40) × (0.55 + 0.45) × (0.65 + 0.35) × (0.60 + 0.40) = 1, or 100% ``` ## The Sixteen Types in Demonstration Scenario A **All figures below are calculated values from a hypothetical scenario; the actual population shares are unknown.** Display values are percentages rounded to one decimal place. This is a presentation choice and does not mean the estimates are accurate to 0.1 percentage points. | ID | Type | Four-pole combination | Unrounded model percentage | Display value | |---|---|---|---:|---:| | T01 | Broker | Gain–Strategy–Instrumental–Justification | 12.87% | 12.9% | | T02 | Opportunist | Gain–Strategy–Instrumental–Disregard | 8.58% | 8.6% | | T03 | Smiler | Gain–Strategy–Punitive–Justification | 6.93% | 6.9% | | T04 | Pursuer | Gain–Strategy–Punitive–Disregard | 4.62% | 4.6% | | T05 | Harvester | Gain–Pressure–Instrumental–Justification | 10.53% | 10.5% | | T06 | Raider | Gain–Pressure–Instrumental–Disregard | 7.02% | 7.0% | | T07 | Collector | Gain–Pressure–Punitive–Justification | 5.67% | 5.7% | | T08 | Bruiser | Gain–Pressure–Punitive–Disregard | 3.78% | 3.8% | | T09 | Puppet Master | Control–Strategy–Instrumental–Justification | 8.58% | 8.6% | | T10 | Agitator | Control–Strategy–Instrumental–Disregard | 5.72% | 5.7% | | T11 | Power Broker | Control–Strategy–Punitive–Justification | 4.62% | 4.6% | | T12 | Cult Leader | Control–Strategy–Punitive–Disregard | 3.08% | 3.1% | | T13 | Enforcer | Control–Pressure–Instrumental–Justification | 7.02% | 7.0% | | T14 | Decider | Control–Pressure–Instrumental–Disregard | 4.68% | 4.7% | | T15 | Arbiter | Control–Pressure–Punitive–Justification | 3.78% | 3.8% | | T16 | Tyrant | Control–Pressure–Punitive–Disregard | 2.52% | 2.5% | | — | Total | — | 100.00% | 100.0% | The display values in this scenario also happen to total exactly 100.0%. With other parameter combinations, rounded values may not total exactly 100%. Any rounding difference should be disclosed and the original calculated values retained; no individual type should be adjusted merely to manufacture differences among types. ## How Much Do the Figures Change Under Different Assumptions? We used several alternative settings to examine how strongly the figures depend on the assumptions. | Demonstration setting | Gain / Strategy / Instrumental / Justification proportions | Broker model share | Tyrant model share | |---|---|---:|---:| | Symmetric baseline | 50% / 50% / 50% / 50% | 6.25% | 6.25% | | Demonstration Scenario A | 60% / 55% / 65% / 60% | 12.87% | 2.52% | | Perturbation Scenario B | 55% / 50% / 60% / 55% | 9.075% | 4.05% | | Perturbation Scenario C | 65% / 60% / 70% / 65% | 17.745% | 1.47% | All rows above provisionally treat the four axes as independent. The symmetric baseline shows only the mathematical consequence of assuming an even split at each pole and independence among the axes; it does not claim that the real population is evenly divided. Scenarios B and C respectively decrease or increase all four inputs from A by 5 percentage points. Those magnitudes are also manually chosen test conditions. Keeping the four axis proportions fixed is still not enough to determine a single answer. For example, A assumes that subjects who are both Strategy and Justification account for 33% of all model subjects. A different relationship among the axes could put that joint share at 40% while preserving the marginal proportions of 55% Strategy and 60% Justification. With all else unchanged, Broker's share would then rise from 12.87% to 15.60%. Both are calculable scenarios, and we have no data for judging which is closer to reality. These results show that the model is sensitive both to the input proportions and to relationships among the axes. The range shown here is **a range of calculations produced by changing assumptions**. It is not a margin of error for the actual population share or a 95% confidence interval. ## How Does This Relate to My Assessment Match Percentage? You may see several kinds of percentages in your results. They answer different questions: | Figure | What it means | |---|---| | Four-axis tendency reading | The relative tendency shown by this set of answers on one axis | | Character match percentage | The relative share of fit between this set of answers and each character under the fixed combination rules | | Population Share (Model Estimate) | A type's share within the model under a given set of distribution assumptions | The population share estimate is not derived from an individual's match score. Under the same scenario version, a given type always has the same model share. It is neither the probability that you belong to that type nor a measure of the assessment's accuracy. Continuing the assessment may update your recommended type, so the type you are viewing and its model estimate may change. This does not mean the population distribution changes in response to your answers. ## Which Parts Have a Basis, and Which Remain Assumptions? | Component | Current status | |---|---| | Meanings of the four axes, type names, and mappings | Defined by this project's published classification | | Inputs of 60%, 55%, 65%, and 60% | Manually chosen demonstration assumptions on this page, with no empirical basis | | Independence of the four axes | A simplifying assumption chosen for the demonstration; not yet validated | | Multiplication formula, values for the sixteen types, and total | Reproducible mathematical results | | Actual population shares, differences among populations, and model error | Currently unknown | Research on dark personality can inform discussion of related concepts. For example, research on the D factor examines a common core shared by multiple dark tendencies. Comparing its definition with this project's four axes does not allow the D factor's statistical findings to be converted directly into population shares for the 16 Shades types.
